sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“简·多伊”（无名氏）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但她的身份确认，反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“案件档案呈现”系列的最新作品，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: warnings, please see the show notes for this episode on your app or on our website.
sentences.zh: 警告，请查看您应用内或我们网站上本集节目的说明。

sentences.en: The capital of the state of Western Australia, Perth, has long been referred to as the most isolated city in the world.
sentences.zh: 西澳大利亚州首府珀斯，长期以来一直被称为世界上最与世隔绝的城市。

sentences.en: While there is some debate as to whether this title is accurate, the fact remains that Perth is the only large city in a circuit of more than 2,000 kilometres.
sentences.zh: 虽然关于这个称号是否准确尚存争议，但事实是，在方圆2000多公里的范围内，珀斯确实是唯一的大城市。

sentences.en: It sits on the other side of the country to the more heavily populated eastern states,
sentences.zh: 它坐落在该国与人口稠密的东部各州相对的一侧，

sentences.en: home to Sydney, Melbourne and Brisbane, and the next nearest capital city is South Australia's
sentences.zh: 那里有悉尼、墨尔本和布里斯班，而距离最近的另一个首府城市是南澳大利亚州的

sentences.en: Adelaide, a 28-hour drive away.
sentences.zh: 阿德莱德，车程需要28小时。

sentences.en: Perth is located in the lower western corner of the state and is adjacent to the Indian Ocean.
sentences.zh: 珀斯位于该州的西南角，毗邻印度洋。

sentences.en: Another body of water, the Swan River, cuts through the middle of Perth, dividing the city in two with much of the central business district built up along its banks.
sentences.zh: 另一片水域——天鹅河，横穿珀斯市中心，将城市一分为二，大部分中央商务区都沿河岸而建。

sentences.en: East of the city is home to sprawling hills and parklands filled with native flora and iconic
sentences.zh: 城市东部有着连绵起伏的丘陵和公园，生长着本土植物和标志性的

sentences.en: Australian bush.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚灌木丛。

sentences.en: Winters in Perth are mild, reaching a top temperature of 19 degrees Celsius on average, while the summers are renowned for their dry heat.
sentences.zh: 珀斯的冬季温和，最高气温平均为19摄氏度，而夏季则以干燥炎热而闻名。

sentences.en: In the warmer months, swimmers and surfers flock to Perth's coastline to enjoy popular beaches such as Cottesloe and Scarborough.
sentences.zh: 在温暖的月份，游泳者和冲浪者蜂拥至珀斯的海岸线，享受科特斯洛和斯卡伯勒等热门海滩。

sentences.en: During the late 1950s, the city was home to about 388,000 people, but was rapidly growing due to a baby boom and post-World War II migration.
sentences.zh: 20世纪50年代末，这座城市约有38.8万人口，但由于婴儿潮和二战后的移民潮，人口正在迅速增长。

sentences.en: Even as the city expanded and swelled, a sense of innocence remained.
sentences.zh: 即使在城市扩张和人口膨胀的过程中，那种纯朴感依然存在。

sentences.en: Nights were quieter.
sentences.zh: 夜晚十分宁静。

sentences.en: Strict licensing laws meant that pubs closed by 9pm.
sentences.zh: 严格的许可法规定酒吧必须在晚上9点前关门。

sentences.en: Dance halls and concerts were a favourite weekend pastime for the city's youth, but they too were governed by restrictions that typically
sentences.zh: 舞厅和音乐会是当地年轻人周末最喜欢的消遣方式，但它们也受到限制，通常

sentences.en: saw the entertainment wind down before midnight.
sentences.zh: 在午夜前就会结束娱乐活动。

sentences.en: Homes were kept unlocked with windows open even at night, drivers parked their cars with the keys in the ignition, and residents were never more
sentences.zh: 家家户户晚上都不锁门，窗户也开着，司机停车时钥匙甚至还插在点火开关上，居民之间

sentences.en: than a couple of degrees of separation from one another.
sentences.zh: 彼此的社交距离通常不超过两层关系。

sentences.en: However, this sense of security and safety that residents took for granted would be shaken and then irrevocably damaged as the city entered the 1960s.
sentences.zh: 然而，随着城市进入20世纪60年代，居民们习以为常的这种安全感将受到动摇，并最终遭到不可逆转的破坏。

sentences.en: Under the cover of darkness, Perth was terrorised by an elusive figure – someone who would eventually be dubbed the Night Caller.
sentences.zh: 在夜幕的掩护下，珀斯被一个难以捉摸的人物所恐吓——他最终被称为“夜间来电者”。

sentences.en: Towards the end of the 1950s, households throughout
sentences.zh: 20世纪50年代末，整个

sentences.en: Perth experienced an uptick in burglaries.
sentences.zh: 珀斯的入室盗窃案有所增加。

sentences.en: Residents would return home from being away or wake in the morning to find that someone had been in their house overnight.
sentences.zh: 居民们外出归来或早晨醒来时，会发现有人在夜间潜入过他们的家中。

sentences.en: Cash that had been left lying around or stashed inside wallets and purses was missing.
sentences.zh: 放在外面或藏在钱包和手袋里的现金不见了。

sentences.en: It could range from a few shillings to pound notes, as Australia was using the pound currency at the time.
sentences.zh: 金额从几先令到英镑不等，因为当时澳大利亚使用的是英镑货币。

sentences.en: Sometimes money was even missing from hiding places such as drawers or inside an ornamental vase.
sentences.zh: 有时，连藏在抽屉或装饰花瓶里的钱也会不翼而飞。

sentences.en: Small objects of varying value were also pocketed.
sentences.zh: 各种价值的小物件也被顺手牵羊。

sentences.en: Watches, pens, jewellery and even a torch were taken.
sentences.zh: 手表、钢笔、珠宝，甚至手电筒都被偷走了。

sentences.en: More disturbingly, women had their underwear stolen.
sentences.zh: 更令人不安的是，女性的内衣也被偷了。

sentences.en: Police reports were typically filed when the crimes were discovered, but officers were left stumped by the lack of fingerprints at any of the crime scenes.
sentences.zh: 警方通常在案件被发现后接到报案，但由于所有犯罪现场都没有留下指纹，警官们对此束手无策。

sentences.en: Other times, residents were entirely unaware that they'd had an intruder at all.
sentences.zh: 有时，居民甚至完全没有意识到家里曾有入侵者。

sentences.en: Sometimes so little of importance was taken that it was never missed or was assumed to have been misplaced.
sentences.zh: 有时被偷的东西微不足道，以至于从未被察觉，或者被认为是自己弄丢了。

sentences.en: These seemed like the crimes of an opportunistic offender seeking financial gain, taking advantage of the lax security measures in place.
sentences.zh: 这些看起来像是投机取巧的罪犯为了经济利益而犯下的罪行，利用了当时松懈的安保措施。

sentences.en: During this time, there were also sightings and reports of a prowler in central and southern
sentences.zh: 在此期间，珀斯中部和南部也出现了

sentences.en: Perth.
sentences.zh: 徘徊者的踪迹和报告。

sentences.en: A man was spotted lurking in the bushes, peeping in windows, and loitering outside of apartment blocks.
sentences.zh: 有人看到一名男子在灌木丛中潜伏，窥视窗户，并在公寓楼外游荡。

sentences.en: Sometimes, his footprints were discovered in garden beds the following morning.
sentences.zh: 有时，第二天早上会在花园里发现他的脚印。

sentences.en: Occasionally, women's nightgowns and underwear left hanging on washing lines were found cut and slashed.
sentences.zh: 偶尔，晾在绳子上的女性睡裙和内衣会被割破。

sentences.en: No one could know that a single person was behind all of these crimes, which were typically written off as minor offenses.
sentences.zh: 没人能想到，所有这些通常被视为轻微犯罪的案件背后，竟然是同一个人所为。

sentences.en: There was seemingly nothing violent about them, but that would soon change.
sentences.zh: 这些罪行表面上看起来并不暴力，但这种情况很快就会改变。

sentences.en: The McLeod family lived in the riverside suburb of Applecross, close to Perth's CBD and just across the Swan River.
sentences.zh: 麦克劳德一家住在河畔的苹果十字区，靠近珀斯中央商务区，就在天鹅河对面。

sentences.en: In the early hours of Wednesday November
sentences.zh: 1958年11月26日星期三的凌晨，

sentences.en: 26, 1958, Lucy and Ern McLeod were woken by a strange commotion in their bedroom.
sentences.zh: 露西和厄恩·麦克劳德被卧室里的一阵奇怪动静惊醒。

sentences.en: Their daughter, 15-year-old Molly, was wandering around the room, tripping over her own feet and retching as though she was going to vomit.
sentences.zh: 他们15岁的女儿莫莉在房间里走来走去，被自己的脚绊倒，并干呕着，好像要呕吐一样。

sentences.en: Molly rambled incoherently, clearly trying to tell her parents something, but she couldn't form the words to speak.
sentences.zh: 莫莉语无伦次地嘟囔着，显然想告诉父母什么，但却无法组织语言。

sentences.en: Terrified, Lucy rushed to her child, who had been fine when she'd gone to bed the previous evening.
sentences.zh: 惊恐万分的露西冲向她的孩子，而孩子前一天晚上睡觉时还好好的。

sentences.en: Lucy and Ern repeatedly asked Molly what had happened, begging her to explain what was wrong
sentences.zh: 露西和厄恩反复询问莫莉发生了什么事，恳求她解释哪里不舒服。

sentences.en: Molly was unable to answer and soon lost consciousness
sentences.zh: 莫莉无法回答，很快就失去了知觉。

sentences.en: Her father carried her back to her room, which was a sleepout that adjoined the family's kitchen and gently laid her in bed
sentences.zh: 父亲把她抱回了房间——那是一个与家里厨房相连的露天卧室，并轻轻地把她放在床上。

sentences.en: Lucy kneeled beside Molly and held a set of rosary beads in her hand, praying repeatedly for her daughter's health
sentences.zh: 露西跪在莫莉身边，手里拿着一串念珠，反复为女儿的健康祈祷。

sentences.en: To her parents' relief, Molly regained consciousness, though she continued to moan and mumble without making any sense
sentences.zh: 令父母欣慰的是，莫莉恢复了知觉，尽管她仍然呻吟和嘟囔着，让人听不懂在说什么。

sentences.en: By morning, Molly was able to string a few words together, enough to tell her parents that her head hurt
sentences.zh: 到了早上，莫莉能连贯地说出几个词了，足以告诉父母她的头很痛。

sentences.en: One of her eyes had turned black, suggesting she'd somehow received a knock to the head
sentences.zh: 她的一只眼睛变成了黑色，这表明她的头部受到了某种撞击。

sentences.en: Lucy McLeod took Molly to the family doctor who was unable to ascertain the cause of Molly's injury but diagnosed her as having a concussion and a hairline skull fracture
sentences.zh: 露西·麦克劳德带莫莉去看家庭医生，医生无法确定莫莉受伤的原因，但诊断她患有脑震荡和颅骨发际线骨折。

sentences.en: It took Molly more than a month to recover
sentences.zh: 莫莉花了一个多月的时间才康复。

sentences.en: A staff student, she had been due to finish high school but was unable to attend her leaving exams
sentences.zh: 作为一名优等生，她本应完成高中学业，但却无法参加毕业考试。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, her family was puzzled over the mystery behind what caused her severe head injury
sentences.zh: 与此同时，她的家人对她头部严重受伤背后的谜团感到困惑。

sentences.en: They eventually concluded that Molly must have received the knock after an awful nightmare caused her to fall out of bed
sentences.zh: 他们最终断定，莫莉一定是在做了一场噩梦后摔下床，才导致头部受伤的。

sentences.en: Molly and her family had no idea that she had actually crossed paths with the night caller
sentences.zh: 莫莉和她的家人根本不知道，她实际上与那个“夜间来电者”擦肩而过。

sentences.en: He had slipped into the McLeod's Applecross home as its residents slept He prowled about looking for cash he could steal and helped himself to some money he found in the kitchen
sentences.zh: 他趁着麦克劳德一家熟睡时潜入了他们位于苹果十字区的家中。他在屋里四处搜寻现金，并顺手拿走了在厨房里发现的一些钱。

sentences.en: As he was opening the back door to escape, his grip on the handle slipped and the noise woke
sentences.zh: 当他打开后门准备逃跑时，手滑了一下，发出的声音惊醒了

sentences.en: Molly, whose bed was right next door.
sentences.zh: 睡在隔壁的莫莉。

sentences.en: Seeing the girl stir, the night caller grabbed a nearby object and hit her over the head with it before fleeing.
sentences.zh: 看到女孩动了动，夜间来电者抓起附近的一个物体砸向她的头部，然后逃之夭夭。

sentences.en: Throughout December 1958 and into the new year, the night caller continued to stalk the streets of Perth.
sentences.zh: 整个1958年12月到新的一年，夜间来电者继续在珀斯的街道上潜行。

sentences.en: Weekends seemed to be when he was most active, though he also ventured out on Tuesday and Thursday evenings.
sentences.zh: 他似乎在周末最活跃，但也曾于周二和周四晚上出没。

sentences.en: His crimes were growing ever more brazen.
sentences.zh: 他的罪行变得越来越猖狂。

sentences.en: At 3am one night, a 21-year-old school teacher who lived in Millpoint Road, South Perth, was woken by a strange man grabbing her by the neck and scratching her face.
sentences.zh: 一天凌晨3点，一位住在南珀斯米尔波因特路的21岁女教师被一个陌生男子惊醒，他抓住了她的脖子并抓伤了她的脸。

sentences.en: She screamed and the intruder jumped out of her bedroom window.
sentences.zh: 她尖叫起来，入侵者从她的卧室窗户跳了出去。

sentences.en: Six weeks after this attack on Wednesday January 28, Perth reached its warmest day of the year when the temperature reached 43 degrees Celsius or 109 degrees Fahrenheit.
sentences.zh: 在这次袭击发生六周后的1月28日星期三，珀斯迎来了全年最热的一天，气温达到43摄氏度（109华氏度）。

sentences.en: That night, a man who lived one street over from where the teacher had been attacked heard a noise outside at 1.50am and went to investigate.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，一位住在女教师遇袭地点隔壁街的男子在凌晨1点50分听到外面有动静，便出去查看。

sentences.en: His sudden appearance disturbed a man trying to break in via the back door.
sentences.zh: 他的突然出现惊动了一名试图从后门闯入的男子。

sentences.en: The prowler fled on foot.
sentences.zh: 徘徊者徒步逃跑了。

sentences.en: A neighbour who had also spotted him watching a block of flats from a nearby phone booth described him as being between 5 foot 8 and 5 foot 10 with thick dark hair.
sentences.zh: 一位邻居也曾看到他在附近的电话亭观察一栋公寓楼，据描述，他身高在5英尺8英寸到5英尺10英寸之间，留着浓密的黑发。

sentences.en: The following day of Thursday January 29, 33-year-old Penina Berkman worked a shift at the perfume counter of the David Jones department store in Perth CBD.
sentences.zh: 第二天，1月29日星期四，33岁的佩妮娜·伯克曼在珀斯中央商务区大卫琼斯百货公司的香水柜台值班。

sentences.en: Penina had relocated to Perth from Melbourne four years earlier after she and her husband divorced.
sentences.zh: 佩妮娜在四年前与丈夫离婚后，从墨尔本搬到了珀斯。

sentences.en: Penina had settled into a ground floor apartment on Millpoint Road in South Perth and was happy there.
sentences.zh: 佩妮娜在南珀斯的米尔波因特路定居在一间一楼的公寓里，在那里生活得很开心。

sentences.en: Even though her flat had been broken into about six months earlier and 35 shillings were stolen, Panina was comfortable in her new city.
sentences.zh: 尽管大约六个月前她的公寓曾被闯入并被偷走了35先令，但佩妮娜对这座新城市感到很自在。

sentences.en: She was a glamorous woman who had caught the eye of a local radio DJ named Fotis Huntis.
sentences.zh: 她是一位迷人的女性，吸引了一位名叫福蒂斯·亨蒂斯的当地电台DJ的注意。

sentences.en: The pair became a couple.
sentences.zh: 两人成为了一对情侣。

sentences.en: They planned to meet up after Panina finished her shift that day.
sentences.zh: 他们计划在佩妮娜当天值完班后见面。

sentences.en: Fotis picked Panina up from David Jones and drove her back to her apartment where they ate dinner together.
sentences.zh: 福蒂斯从大卫琼斯接上佩妮娜，开车送她回公寓，两人一起吃了晚饭。

sentences.en: Later on, they drank some beer then went to bed together.
sentences.zh: 后来，他们喝了一些啤酒，然后一起上床睡觉了。

sentences.en: At midnight, Fotis got dressed and prepared to head home to sleep.
sentences.zh: 午夜时分，福蒂斯穿好衣服，准备回家睡觉。

sentences.en: As he left, Penina said goodnight and that she would see him tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 他离开时，佩妮娜说了晚安，并说明天见。

sentences.en: Neighbours overheard Fotis' footsteps as he departed the building and heard some other things in the hours that followed.
sentences.zh: 邻居们听到了福蒂斯离开大楼时的脚步声，并在随后的几个小时里听到了一些其他动静。

sentences.en: At around 3am, a couple in an apartment next to Penina's were woken by the sound of someone gasping, followed by a scream.
sentences.zh: 凌晨3点左右，佩妮娜隔壁公寓的一对夫妇被一阵喘息声惊醒，随后是一声尖叫。

sentences.en: A few minutes later, they heard a car door slam, then the car driving away.
sentences.zh: 几分钟后，他们听到车门关上的声音，然后是汽车驶离的声音。

sentences.en: Another resident also heard some screams and a car leaving at around the same time.
sentences.zh: 另一位居民也在大约同一时间听到了尖叫声和汽车离开的声音。

sentences.en: The next morning, Fotis drove by Panina's apartment on his way to an appointment and noticed that the door was ajar and her bedroom window was open,
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，福蒂斯在去赴约的路上开车经过佩妮娜的公寓，发现门半开着，卧室的窗户也开着，

sentences.en: its curtains blowing in the breeze.
sentences.zh: 窗帘在微风中飘动。

sentences.en: Penina often slept with the window open during the hot summer nights, but Fotis knew that she always made a point to close everything and lock up before heading to work.
sentences.zh: 佩妮娜在炎热的夏夜经常开着窗睡觉，但福蒂斯知道，她总是会在上班前把所有东西关好锁上。

sentences.en: She was supposed to have a shift that day, so the apartment should have been secured.
sentences.zh: 她那天本应有班，所以公寓本该是锁好的。

sentences.en: Fotis decided to investigate.
sentences.zh: 福蒂斯决定进去查看。

sentences.en: Inside, he found Penina on the lounge room floor by the sliding glass doors.
sentences.zh: 在里面，他发现佩妮娜倒在滑动玻璃门旁的客厅地板上。

sentences.en: She was naked in a pool of blood.
sentences.zh: 她赤身裸体，倒在血泊中。

sentences.en: She had been stabbed through the nose and in the heart with a knife.
sentences.zh: 她的鼻子和心脏被刀刺中。

sentences.en: It appeared Panina had crawled to the doors in an attempt to escape, but hadn't survived.
sentences.zh: 看起来佩妮娜曾爬向门口试图逃生，但没能活下来。

sentences.en: Nothing was missing from the apartment except for Panina's purse.
sentences.zh: 公寓里除了佩妮娜的钱包外，什么都没丢。

sentences.en: The murder weapon wasn't recovered.
sentences.zh: 凶器没有找到。

sentences.en: The horrific murder sent shockwaves through
sentences.zh: 这起恐怖的谋杀案在

sentences.en: Perth.
sentences.zh: 珀斯引起了轰动。

sentences.en: Crimes like this were a rarity in the quiet city.
sentences.zh: 在这座安静的城市里，这样的罪行非常罕见。

sentences.en: Fotis Huntis told police that when he left Penina's apartment, she had been naked in bed.
sentences.zh: 福蒂斯·亨蒂斯告诉警方，当他离开佩妮娜的公寓时，她赤身裸体躺在床上。

sentences.en: It wasn't unusual for her to sleep naked in hot weather.
sentences.zh: 她在炎热的天气里裸睡并不罕见。

sentences.en: Fotis quickly found himself the case's prime suspect and the public agreed that he seemed suspicious.
sentences.zh: 福蒂斯很快发现自己成了此案的主要嫌疑人，公众也认为他看起来很可疑。

sentences.en: When Fotis left Perth to return to his birth country of Greece, their suspicions were all but confirmed.
sentences.zh: 当福蒂斯离开珀斯回到他的出生国希腊时，他们的怀疑几乎得到了证实。

sentences.en: Penina's killer had gotten away.
sentences.zh: 佩妮娜的凶手逍遥法外了。

sentences.en: Even though Penina lived on the same street where a 21-year-old teacher had been attacked in her own home just six weeks
sentences.zh: 尽管佩妮娜住的那条街上，六周前刚有一位21岁的女教师在自己家中遇袭，

sentences.en: earlier, police didn't consider that her murder could be part of a larger picture.
sentences.zh: 但警方并没有考虑她的谋杀案可能是更大图景的一部分。

sentences.en: They reassured worried Perth residents, stating,
sentences.zh: 他们安抚了担忧的珀斯居民，声称：

sentences.en: The public have no need to be feared from the activities of the person who killed Penina
sentences.zh: “公众无需担心杀害佩妮娜·伯克曼的人的行径，

sentences.en: Berkman, and they can forget all about the existence of that person.
sentences.zh: 他们可以完全忘记那个人的存在。”

sentences.en: Residents of Perth's western suburbs felt somewhat detached from the murder of Penina Berkman as she had been living in South Perth.
sentences.zh: 珀斯西郊的居民对佩妮娜·伯克曼的谋杀案感到有些疏离，因为她住在南珀斯。

sentences.en: Although that wasn't far in terms of distance, it almost felt like another world due to the Swan River providing a geographical buffer.
sentences.zh: 虽然从距离上看并不远，但由于天鹅河提供了地理屏障，感觉就像是另一个世界。

sentences.en: Moreover, the inner western suburbs were an affluent and insular pocket that felt particularly safe with a tight-knit community.
sentences.zh: 此外，内西郊是一个富裕且封闭的区域，由于社区紧密，感觉特别安全。

sentences.en: One of these wealthy suburbs was Nedlands, an attractive neighbourhood just seven kilometres west of the CBD.
sentences.zh: 内德兰兹就是这些富裕郊区之一，这是一个距离中央商务区仅七公里的迷人社区。

sentences.en: Dotted with nice houses and lots of parks, Nedlands was also close to the University of Western Australia.
sentences.zh: 内德兰兹点缀着漂亮的房子和许多公园，也靠近西澳大利亚大学。

sentences.en: This made it a popular suburb for students who primarily lived in the area's apartment buildings.
sentences.zh: 这使得它成为学生们的热门郊区，他们主要住在该地区的公寓楼里。

sentences.en: In August 1959, Alex Duncan was a first-year nursing student who was staying at her elder sister's flat in Nedlands.
sentences.zh: 1959年8月，亚历克斯·邓肯是一名一年级护理系学生，当时住在她姐姐位于内德兰兹的公寓里。

sentences.en: Saturday August 8 was going to be a break from Alex's busy work and study schedule.
sentences.zh: 8月8日星期六，亚历克斯繁忙的工作和学习计划将迎来一个休息日。

sentences.en: Some friends from her hometown were visiting for the weekend.
sentences.zh: 她家乡的一些朋友周末来访，

sentences.en: and Alex was looking forward to seeing them.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯很期待见到他们。

sentences.en: Alex and her friends spent the evening at a drive-in cinema, then headed back to Alex's flat to drink coffee and listen to records.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯和她的朋友们在汽车影院度过了晚上，然后回到亚历克斯的公寓喝咖啡、听唱片。

sentences.en: At 12.45am, Alex's guests left and she got ready for bed.
sentences.zh: 凌晨12点45分，亚历克斯的客人们离开了，她准备睡觉。

sentences.en: A security-conscious person, Alex made sure to lock the front door and close all the windows.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯是一个有安全意识的人，她确保锁好前门并关上所有的窗户。

sentences.en: The exception was one narrow window in the kitchen which led to an outdoor landing
sentences.zh: 唯一的例外是厨房里一扇通往室外平台的窄窗。

sentences.en: Because the window was so narrow, Alex felt comfortable leaving it slightly ajar while she slept
sentences.zh: 因为窗户很窄，亚历克斯觉得睡觉时稍微开着它也没关系。

sentences.en: The following morning, Alex's friends from out of town headed over to her flat for a planned visit
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，亚历克斯从外地来的朋友们按计划前往她的公寓探访。

sentences.en: George and Headley were both farmers who lived in Western Australia's Wheatbelt, about an hour and a half outside of Perth
sentences.zh: 乔治和赫德利都是农民，住在西澳大利亚州的麦田区，距离珀斯约一个半小时车程。

sentences.en: The young men knocked on the door and were shocked when Alex opened it.
sentences.zh: 这两个年轻人敲了敲门，当亚历克斯打开门时，他们惊呆了。

sentences.en: Her face and hair were soaked with blood due to a deep wound over her left eye.
sentences.zh: 由于左眼上方有一道深深的伤口，她的脸和头发都被血浸透了。

sentences.en: Still wearing her pyjamas, Alex was disoriented and clearly oblivious to the injury.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯还穿着睡衣，神志不清，显然没有意识到自己受了伤。

sentences.en: George and Hedley searched the apartment.
sentences.zh: 乔治和赫德利搜查了公寓。

sentences.en: Alex's pillow was drenched with blood and her purse was missing.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯的枕头被血浸透了，她的钱包不见了。

sentences.en: She told George and Hedley that there had been six pounds inside the purse, but she struggled to answer other questions.
sentences.zh: 她告诉乔治和赫德利，钱包里有六英镑，但她很难回答其他问题。

sentences.en: When asked about the previous night, Alex said she'd woken up at 3.30am then fallen back asleep.
sentences.zh: 当被问及前一天晚上时，亚历克斯说她在凌晨3点30分醒来，然后又睡着了。

sentences.en: She couldn't recall anything else.
sentences.zh: 她记不起其他任何事情了。

sentences.en: George and Hedley couldn't see any sign of forced entry, but it was clear their friend had been attacked and robbed.
sentences.zh: 乔治和赫德利没有发现任何强行闯入的迹象，但很明显他们的朋友遭到了袭击和抢劫。

sentences.en: They arranged to take Alex to the doctor.
sentences.zh: 他们安排带亚历克斯去看医生。

sentences.en: An examination revealed she also sustained a small fracture to the back of her skull.
sentences.zh: 检查显示她的后脑勺也受到了一处小骨折。

sentences.en: That, plus the injury above her eye, indicated she'd been hit twice.
sentences.zh: 那处伤加上她眼睛上方的伤，表明她被击中了两次。

sentences.en: The attack left Alex with a severe epilepsy that she would need to treat with medication for the rest of her life.
sentences.zh: 那次袭击导致亚历克斯患上了严重的癫痫，余生都需要药物治疗。

sentences.en: She was unable to continue her studies or achieve her dream of becoming a nurse.
sentences.zh: 她无法继续学业，也无法实现成为护士的梦想。

sentences.en: Alex's uncle was a special investigator in the police's criminal investigation branch and the attack against his niece was taken very seriously.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯的叔叔是警方刑事调查部门的一名特别调查员，他对侄女遇袭一事非常重视。

sentences.en: Officers searched the apartment but found no fingerprints.
sentences.zh: 警官搜查了公寓，但没有发现任何指纹。

sentences.en: A poker was missing from the fireplace which they speculated could have been used to inflict Alex's injuries.
sentences.zh: 壁炉里的火钳不见了，他们推测这可能就是造成亚历克斯受伤的凶器。

sentences.en: They took note that the kitchen window was the only point of entry for an intruder.
sentences.zh: 他们注意到厨房窗户是入侵者进入室内的唯一途径。

sentences.en: Yet, with no evidence leading to a specific person, there was little they could do.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于没有线索指向特定嫌疑人，他们能做的非常有限。

sentences.en: Four months later, residents of Perth were preparing for another sun-soaked summer.
sentences.zh: 四个月后，珀斯的居民们正准备迎接又一个阳光明媚的夏天。

sentences.en: One week before Christmas on Saturday December 19, 22-year-old
sentences.zh: 圣诞节前一周，12月19日星期六，22岁的

sentences.en: Gillian Brewer invited her fiancé over to her home in Brookwood Flats, a two-storey red brick apartment complex in the beachside suburb of Cotterslow.
sentences.zh: 吉莉安·布鲁尔邀请未婚夫到她位于科特斯洛海滨郊区的布鲁克伍德公寓家中做客，那是一栋两层高的红砖公寓楼。

sentences.en: Gillian was well known in Perth as a socialite and an heiress whose great-grandfather had founded the chocolate company McRobertson's
sentences.zh: 吉莉安在珀斯是一位名媛，也是一位女继承人，她的曾祖父创立了麦克罗伯逊巧克力公司

sentences.en: Confectionary.
sentences.zh: 糖果公司。

sentences.en: After growing up in Melbourne and beginning a career in interior design,
sentences.zh: 在墨尔本长大并开始从事室内设计工作后，

sentences.en: Gillian had flown west to Perth at the age of 21.
sentences.zh: 吉莉安在21岁时飞往西部的珀斯。

sentences.en: She was happy in her new city, settling into an apartment next door to her mother's and living with her small French poodle Dior for company.
sentences.zh: 她在新城市生活得很开心，搬进了母亲隔壁的公寓，并养了一只名叫迪奥的小型法国贵宾犬作伴。

sentences.en: Gillian would be getting married in two months' time to her 31-year-old fiancé Andrew, not his real name.
sentences.zh: 两个月后，吉莉安就要嫁给31岁的未婚夫安德鲁（化名）。

sentences.en: Andrew and Gillian spent that Saturday together before returning to her apartment for the evening.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁和吉莉安一起度过了那个星期六，晚上回到了她的公寓。

sentences.en: Gillian's flat was on the ground floor and at the back of the complex.
sentences.zh: 吉莉安的公寓位于底层，在建筑群的后方。

sentences.en: Andrew went home at around midnight, with the plan to play golf with Gillian the next day.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁在午夜左右回家，计划第二天和吉莉安一起去打高尔夫球。

sentences.en: At 9am, Andrew went to pick Gillian up and found her front door locked.
sentences.zh: 早上9点，安德鲁去接吉莉安，发现她的前门锁着。

sentences.en: This was unusual, as she mostly kept it open when she was up.
sentences.zh: 这很不寻常，因为她起床时通常都会开着门。

sentences.en: Andrew could see Gillian's poodle Dior jumping up and down frantically at the bedroom window.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁看到吉莉安的贵宾犬迪奥在卧室窗户旁疯狂地跳上跳下。

sentences.en: Andrew had a key to
sentences.zh: 安德鲁的车里有

sentences.en: Jillian's apartment in his car, so he went back to get it and then let himself in.
sentences.zh: 吉莉安公寓的钥匙，于是他回去取了钥匙，然后自己开了门进去。

sentences.en: The kitchen window was open and a breeze had blown some Christmas cards Jillian had out on display onto the floor.
sentences.zh: 厨房的窗户开着，微风把吉莉安摆在外面展示的几张圣诞贺卡吹到了地上。

sentences.en: Unusually, the door to Jillian's bedroom was closed.
sentences.zh: 不同寻常的是，吉莉安卧室的门关着。

sentences.en: Andrew had never seen it shut before.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁以前从未见过这扇门关上。

sentences.en: He opened the door and saw Jillian lying in bed, a sheet pulled all the way up to her chin and a pillow lying on her chest.
sentences.zh: 他推开门，看到吉莉安躺在床上，床单一直拉到下巴处，胸口上放着一个枕头。

sentences.en: Her face was covered in blood, as was the sheet
sentences.zh: 她的脸上满是鲜血，床单上也是，

sentences.en: and the wall behind her.
sentences.zh: 身后的墙上也是。

sentences.en: Andrew raced next door to Jillian's mother's apartment and called for a doctor.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁冲到隔壁吉莉安母亲的公寓，叫了医生。

sentences.en: Upon arriving at the scene, the doctor in turn phoned the police.
sentences.zh: 医生到达现场后，随即报了警。

sentences.en: After removing the sheet, officers saw the extent of Gillian's injuries.
sentences.zh: 移开床单后，警官们看到了吉莉安伤势的严重程度。

sentences.en: She was naked and had wounds all over her body that had been inflicted with a hatchet.
sentences.zh: 她赤身裸体，全身布满了被斧头砍伤的伤口。

sentences.en: Her breasts, head and genitals had all been struck.
sentences.zh: 她的胸部、头部和生殖器都遭到了重创。

sentences.en: Using the flat side of the hatchet, the killer had also hit Gillian's stomach, thighs, face and throat.
sentences.zh: 凶手还用斧头的平侧面击打了吉莉安的腹部、大腿、脸部和喉咙。

sentences.en: This final blow had been hard enough to sever her windpipe.
sentences.zh: 这最后一击力道极大，足以切断她的气管。

sentences.en: Then the killer had used a pair of scissors that belonged to Gillian to stab her five times.
sentences.zh: 随后，凶手用吉莉安自己的一把剪刀刺了她五次。

sentences.en: An autopsy would later reveal that Gillian had likely remained alive for two to three hours after the attack, with the coroner stating it was the worst murder he had ever seen.
sentences.zh: 尸检后来显示，吉莉安在遇袭后可能还存活了二到三个小时，验尸官称这是他见过最惨无人道的谋杀案。

sentences.en: The killer covered her with a sheet and wiped the scissors clean before returning them to their usual spot.
sentences.zh: 凶手用床单盖住她，把剪刀擦干净，然后放回了原处。

sentences.en: Blood was later found on the inner blades of the scissors, indicating they had been closed when the killer wiped them down.
sentences.zh: 后来在剪刀内侧刀刃上发现了血迹，说明凶手擦拭时剪刀是合上的。

sentences.en: He had taken the hatchet with him and tossed it over the back fence.
sentences.zh: 他带走了斧头，并把它扔过了后院的栅栏。

sentences.en: Police found it lying on the ground on the other side, still covered with the Gillian's blood.
sentences.zh: 警方在栅栏另一侧的地上发现了它，上面还沾着吉莉安的血。

sentences.en: The killer had been so forceful when using it that the wooden handle was split near the head.
sentences.zh: 凶手使用时用力过猛，导致木柄在斧头附近断裂。

sentences.en: The hatchet was found to have been stolen from a home in the street behind Jillian's.
sentences.zh: 经查，这把斧头是从吉莉安家后街的一户人家偷来的。

sentences.en: There were no clues as to the killer's identity.
sentences.zh: 关于凶手的身份没有任何线索。

sentences.en: He hadn't left any fingerprints and there was no sign of forced entry at Jillian's apartment.
sentences.zh: 他没有留下任何指纹，吉莉安的公寓也没有强行闯入的迹象。

sentences.en: Both the front and back doors were locked.
sentences.zh: 前门和后门都锁着。

sentences.en: None of Jillian's neighbours had seen anything untoward, though a mother and daughter who lived nearby reported hearing Jillian's dog bark at around 1am.
sentences.zh: 吉莉安的邻居都没有看到任何异常，不过住在附近的一对母女报告说，凌晨1点左右听到吉莉安的狗在叫。

sentences.en: The barking abruptly stopped, as though someone had reprimanded the animal In the days that followed, Gillian's murder dominated newspaper headlines
sentences.zh: 叫声戛然而止，好像有人训斥了那只动物。随后的几天里，吉莉安的谋杀案占据了报纸头条。

sentences.en: As well as the horror of the crime itself, there was the fact that police didn't have a suspect
sentences.zh: 除了罪行本身的恐怖之外，警方没有嫌疑人也是一个事实。

sentences.en: No one in Gillian's life was thought to be responsible
sentences.zh: 吉莉安生活中的任何人都被认为与此无关。

sentences.en: Her purse was missing from the apartment, indicating her killer had stolen it
sentences.zh: 她的钱包在公寓里不见了，说明凶手偷走了它。

sentences.en: The pathologist who observed Gillian and Penina's bodies noted the similarities between their injuries
sentences.zh: 观察过吉莉安和佩妮娜尸体的病理学家注意到了她们伤势之间的相似之处。

sentences.en: Both had been stabbed multiple times while asleep in bed
sentences.zh: 两人都是在睡梦中被多次刺伤。

sentences.en: A journalist at the tabloid The Daily News also compared the crimes pointing out the striking similarities between the women's living circumstances
sentences.zh: 小报《每日新闻》的一名记者也对这些罪行进行了比较，指出了这两名女性生活环境之间的惊人相似之处：

sentences.en: their missing purses and how their killers hadn't left a trace
sentences.zh: 她们丢失的钱包，以及凶手都没有留下任何痕迹。

sentences.en: But investigators firmly believed Penina had been killed by her boyfriend and that Gillian was attacked by a stranger
sentences.zh: 但调查人员坚信佩妮娜是被男友杀害的，而吉莉安则是被陌生人袭击的。

sentences.en: Police looked into known sex offenders in the area as the injuries to Gillian's breasts and groin appeared to indicate a sexual motivation
sentences.zh: 警方调查了该地区的已知性犯罪者，因为吉莉安胸部和腹股沟的伤势似乎表明存在性动机。

sentences.en: It would turn out that over the past 11 months there had been 8 reports of a prowler lurking around the Brookwood flat
sentences.zh: 事实证明，在过去的11个月里，有8起关于布鲁克伍德公寓附近有潜行者的报告。

sentences.en: Someone had broken into apartments there and taken money, alcohol and keys.
sentences.zh: 有人闯入那里的公寓，偷走了钱、酒和钥匙。

sentences.en: One time a car was stolen.
sentences.zh: 有一次，一辆车被偷了。

sentences.en: A number of these reports were made by Gillian's mother, Betty, who lived in the flat next door to her daughter.
sentences.zh: 其中一些报告是由吉莉安的母亲贝蒂提出的，她就住在女儿隔壁的公寓里。

sentences.en: Her first report came just three weeks after Penina Berkman's murder in January at the start of the year.
sentences.zh: 她的第一次报告是在年初1月佩妮娜·伯克曼被谋杀仅三周后提出的。

sentences.en: If the murder of Penina Berkman shocked Perth months earlier, this second slaying left it reeling.
sentences.zh: 如果说几个月前佩妮娜·伯克曼的谋杀案震惊了珀斯，那么这第二起谋杀案则让整个城市陷入了恐慌。

sentences.en: Not only was it another brutal killing in a city that saw few crimes of that nature, but Gillian Brewer's wealth and social status elevated the public's horror to new heights.
sentences.zh: 这不仅是这座鲜有此类犯罪的城市发生的又一起残忍杀戮，吉莉安·布鲁尔的财富和社会地位更将公众的恐惧推向了新的高度。

sentences.en: Gillian had lived in Cottesloe, one of the affluent western suburbs that felt cushioned from Penina's murder.
sentences.zh: 吉莉安住在科特斯洛，这是富裕的西部郊区之一，那里的人们感觉自己远离了佩妮娜谋杀案的阴影。

sentences.en: Residents who also lived in Perth's comfortable western enclave could relate to Gillian
sentences.zh: 同样住在珀斯舒适西部飞地的居民们对吉莉安感同身受。

sentences.en: She was one of us, a community member later told filmmakers of the 2020 documentary series After the Night
sentences.zh: “她是我们的同类，”一位社区成员后来告诉2020年纪录片系列《夜幕之后》的制作人。

sentences.en: As well as dominating the news cycle, Gillian's murder became the focus of many local conversations
sentences.zh: 除了占据新闻周期外，吉莉安的谋杀案也成为了许多当地人谈论的焦点。

sentences.en: The Brookwood flats where she'd lived and died were now a public spectacle with parents driving their children past the building so they could stare at it through the car windows.
sentences.zh: 她生前居住并遇害的布鲁克伍德公寓现在成了公众围观的景点，父母们开车带着孩子经过这栋建筑，好让他们透过车窗盯着看。

sentences.en: Even through their fear and anxiety, most Perth residents felt assured that police would soon catch the person responsible.
sentences.zh: 尽管心怀恐惧和焦虑，大多数珀斯居民仍确信警方很快就会抓住凶手。

sentences.en: They trusted law enforcement to complete a thorough investigation and keep the public safe.
sentences.zh: 他们相信执法部门会进行彻底的调查并保障公众安全。

sentences.en: Despite their faith, weeks and then months passed with no arrest in the case.
sentences.zh: 尽管他们充满信心，但几周、几个月过去了，案件仍未有人被捕。
