sentences.en: 1960 dawned and Perth welcomed another new year.
sentences.zh: 1960年黎明到来，珀斯迎来了又一个新年。

sentences.en: The city had continued to grow, both in size and population.
sentences.zh: 这座城市在规模和人口上都在持续增长。

sentences.en: Also on the increase was the number of break-ins and prowler encounters being reported to the police.
sentences.zh: 向警方报告的入室盗窃和潜行者遭遇的数量也在增加。

sentences.en: Sometimes cars were stolen from driveways and garages.
sentences.zh: 有时汽车会从车道和车库中被偷走。

sentences.en: These were later found either abandoned somewhere else in the city or returned with a slightly emptier petrol tank.
sentences.zh: 这些车后来要么在城里的其他地方被发现遗弃，要么被送回时油箱空了一些。

sentences.en: Neighbourhoods all over Perth were being targeted, from south of the river suburbs like Como and South Perth to those just north and west of the city.
sentences.zh: 珀斯各地的社区都成为了目标，从河以南的科莫和南珀斯郊区，到城市以北和以西的地区。

sentences.en: These crimes continued over the following years.
sentences.zh: 这些犯罪在随后的几年里持续发生。

sentences.en: Sometimes the same target was hit twice.
sentences.zh: 有时同一个目标会被袭击两次。

sentences.en: In March 1961, a tin of silver coins were stolen from a residence in Swambourne, close to Cottesloe Beach.
sentences.zh: 1961年3月，一罐银币从靠近科特斯洛海滩的斯旺伯恩的一处住宅中被盗。

sentences.en: Two weeks later, a 24-year-old woman inside the same home was attacked by an intruder after she heard him break in.
sentences.zh: 两周后，同一住所内的一名24岁女性在听到入侵者闯入后遭到了袭击。

sentences.en: As she tried to phone for help, the intruder grabbed her by the throat and wrestled her to the floor.
sentences.zh: 当她试图打电话求救时，入侵者掐住她的喉咙，将她摔倒在地。

sentences.en: She briefly lost consciousness, then came to and managed to kick the man in the groin.
sentences.zh: 她短暂地失去了知觉，随后醒来并设法踢了那个男人的腹股沟。

sentences.en: He fled out the back door and the woman ran to the window to watch him go.
sentences.zh: 他从后门逃走，女子跑到窗边看着他离开。

sentences.en: Under the sharp glow of the streetlights, she saw that he was white, between
sentences.zh: 在路灯明亮的光线下，她看到他是个白人，身高在

sentences.en: 5'6 and 5'8 and well built.
sentences.zh: 5英尺6英寸到5英尺8英寸之间，身材魁梧。

sentences.en: His face was broad and clean-shaven and he had dark, wavy hair.
sentences.zh: 他的脸很宽，刮得干干净净，留着深色的波浪发。

sentences.en: On another occasion in 1962, a woman was cleaning up after a party her teenaged daughter had held at their Cottesloe home.
sentences.zh: 1962年的另一次事件中，一位女士正在清理她十几岁的女儿在科特斯洛家中举办派对后的现场。

sentences.en: As she did so, she noticed a man outside the house watching her.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，她注意到房子外面有一个男人在盯着她看。

sentences.en: He was lurking behind a bush, wearing a large brimmed hat.
sentences.zh: 他躲在灌木丛后面，戴着一顶宽边帽。

sentences.en: The woman told her husband, who chased after the man, but lost him in the darkness.
sentences.zh: 这位女士告诉了丈夫，丈夫追了上去，但在黑暗中跟丢了人。

sentences.en: On Saturday March 3, 1962, a 23-year-old named Anne Melvin was feeling nervous.
sentences.zh: 1962年3月3日星期六，一位名叫安妮·梅尔文的23岁女性感到很紧张。

sentences.en: She'd moved out of her childhood home just a few weeks earlier and was now sharing a flat with her sister in the western suburb of Crawley.
sentences.zh: 她几周前刚搬出童年的家，现在正和姐姐在西部的克劳利郊区合租一套公寓。

sentences.en: Anne's sister was out that night and it would be the first time Anne had stayed in the flat alone.
sentences.zh: 安妮的姐姐那天晚上出去了，这将是安妮第一次独自留在公寓里。

sentences.en: She made herself a snack and was having a coffee when she heard a noise on the porch outside.
sentences.zh: 她给自己做了点零食，正在喝咖啡时，听到门廊外有动静。

sentences.en: Anne paused and listened carefully.
sentences.zh: 安妮停下来仔细听着。

sentences.en: When she didn't hear anything else, she told herself it must have been a cat.
sentences.zh: 当她没再听到其他声音时，她告诉自己那一定是只猫。

sentences.en: Anne went to bed and slept peacefully for a little while, before she suddenly started having an awful nightmare.
sentences.zh: 安妮上床睡了一会儿，睡得很安稳，突然开始做起可怕的噩梦。

sentences.en: In the dream, she was suffocating.
sentences.zh: 在梦里，她快要窒息了。

sentences.en: Anne forced herself awake only to realise that she wasn't just dreaming.
sentences.zh: 安妮强迫自己醒来，却意识到这不仅仅是在做梦。

sentences.en: A piece of toweling was wrapped tightly around her neck.
sentences.zh: 一块毛巾紧紧地缠在她的脖子上。

sentences.en: Her left arm had been tied to the bedhead with a stocking.
sentences.zh: 她的左臂被一双长筒袜绑在床头上，

sentences.en: and most terrifying of all, there was a man standing next to her bed, removing his belt.
sentences.zh: 最可怕的是，床边站着一个男人，正在解他的皮带。

sentences.en: Anne sat up, tore desperately at the toweling at her neck and began to scream.
sentences.zh: 安妮坐起来，拼命撕扯脖子上的毛巾，开始尖叫。

sentences.en: At the sound of her yells, the man ran out of the room.
sentences.zh: 听到她的尖叫声，那个男人跑出了房间。

sentences.en: Anne managed to free her arm and took off after him, screaming that she was going to kill him.
sentences.zh: 安妮设法挣脱了手臂，追了出去，尖叫着说她要杀了他。

sentences.en: In her terror and confusion, she had forgotten that her sister was away for the evening and when Anne saw her empty bed, she believed the intruder must have kidnapped her.
sentences.zh: 在恐惧和混乱中，她忘记了姐姐当晚不在家，当安妮看到姐姐空着的床时，她以为入侵者一定绑架了她。

sentences.en: The man got away but Anne's screams attracted the attention of some nearby neighbours who found her on her balcony with blood dribbling from her mouth.
sentences.zh: 那个男人逃走了，但安妮的尖叫声引起了附近一些邻居的注意，他们发现她站在阳台上，嘴里流着血。

sentences.en: One of the neighbours comforted Anne while the other called the police.
sentences.zh: 一位邻居安慰安妮，另一位报了警。

sentences.en: A detective who soon arrived was shocked to see Anne's appearance.
sentences.zh: 不久后赶到的侦探看到安妮的样子大吃一惊。

sentences.en: She looked as though she was almost dead, with bloodshot eyes and raw red markings on her neck and wriSt.
sentences.zh: 她看起来几乎快要死了，眼睛充血，脖子和手腕上有红肿的勒痕。

sentences.en: Anne moved back in with her parents after the attack and would only leave the house to go to church.
sentences.zh: 袭击发生后，安妮搬回了父母家，只有去教堂时才会出门。

sentences.en: Terrified her attacker would track her down, she eventually left Australia altogether.
sentences.zh: 因为害怕袭击者会找到她，她最终彻底离开了澳大利亚。

sentences.en: together.
sentences.zh: 离开了。

sentences.en: A few days after the attack against Anne Melvin, the couple who had come to her rescue woke to find their car covered in pairs of women's underpants.
sentences.zh: 袭击安妮·梅尔文几天后，救了她的那对夫妇醒来发现他们的车上覆盖着多条女性内裤。

sentences.en: They had been twisted around door handles, tucked under the windscreen wipers, and stuck into any available gaps.
sentences.zh: 它们被缠在门把手上，塞在挡风玻璃雨刷下，并塞进了所有能塞进去的缝隙里。

sentences.en: The couple notified the police who attended the property and found footprints in the garden beds.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇通知了警方，警方来到现场，在花园里发现了脚印。

sentences.en: Some of the plants were trampled
sentences.zh: 一些植物被踩踏了。

sentences.en: It appeared as though someone had been lurking in the area, looking through the windows In the months that followed, there were more reports of a prowler around Perth
sentences.zh: 看起来好像有人一直在该地区潜伏，透过窗户窥视。在随后的几个月里，珀斯周围又出现了更多关于潜行者的报告。

sentences.en: On one occasion on Saturday December 29 1962, a woman in Cottesloe woke to find a man in her room
sentences.zh: 1962年12月29日星期六，科特斯洛的一位女士醒来发现房间里有一个男人。

sentences.en: He'd wrapped a handkerchief around his face as a disguise and was shining a torch in her eyes.
sentences.zh: 他用手帕蒙住脸作为伪装，正用手电筒照着她的眼睛。

sentences.en: The man punched her face before fleeing.
sentences.zh: 那个男人打了她的脸，然后逃跑了。

sentences.en: Later that same night, another young woman in Cottesloe was woken by the same prowler.
sentences.zh: 当天晚上晚些时候，科特斯洛的另一位年轻女性被同一个潜行者吵醒。

sentences.en: In addition to the handkerchief, he wore a hat and had leather gloves on his hands as well as what looked like a knuckle duster.
sentences.zh: 除了手帕，他还戴着帽子，手上戴着皮手套，还拿着看起来像指虎的东西。

sentences.en: He hit her over the head with the torch before punching above her eye
sentences.zh: 他用手电筒击打她的头部，然后重击她的眼睛上方。

sentences.en: The woman screamed, which woke her parents as well as some neighbours
sentences.zh: 女子尖叫起来，惊醒了她的父母和一些邻居。

sentences.en: By the time her parents reached her bedroom, the attacker had fled
sentences.zh: 当她的父母赶到卧室时，袭击者已经逃跑了。

sentences.en: It would later turn out that he had stolen cash from the young woman's purse
sentences.zh: 后来发现，他从这位年轻女性的钱包里偷走了现金。

sentences.en: An internal police report on this latter attack noticed that over the past six months there had been a pattern of break-and-enters at homes in the area.
sentences.zh: 一份关于后一起袭击的内部警方报告指出，在过去六个月里，该地区的住宅入室盗窃案呈现出一种模式。

sentences.en: Whoever was behind the break-ins was entering via unlocked doors and open windows.
sentences.zh: 无论谁是这些入室盗窃案的幕后黑手，都是通过未锁的门和打开的窗户进入的。

sentences.en: The offender would steal cash and his crimes appeared to be escalating.
sentences.zh: 罪犯会偷走现金，而且他的犯罪行为似乎在升级。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引文：

sentences.en: Of late, these reports have become more frequent and some concern is being felt for the safety of
sentences.zh: 近来，这些报告变得更加频繁，人们对以下人员的安全感到担忧：

sentences.en: women who are being disturbed by the offender after he has entered the premises and stolen on what money he can find.
sentences.zh: 那些在罪犯进入住所并偷走他能找到的钱财后，受到惊扰的女性。

sentences.en: One witness who saw the offender fleeing described him as being aged between 30 and 40 with a tan complexion.
sentences.zh: 一位目击罪犯逃跑的证人描述他年龄在30到40岁之间，肤色黝黑。

sentences.en: His height was short at around 5 foot 9 and he had a thin to medium build.
sentences.zh: 他个子较矮，大约5英尺9英寸，身材偏瘦到中等。

sentences.en: The offender wore a suit as well as a black felt hat with a wide brim and close-fitting white gloves.
sentences.zh: 罪犯穿着西装，戴着一顶宽檐黑色毡帽，还戴着一副紧身白手套。

sentences.en: Sometimes his face was masked.
sentences.zh: 有时他会戴着面具。

sentences.en: He never left fingerprints behind and he never spoke.
sentences.zh: 他从不留下指纹，也从不开口说话。

sentences.en: The report was distributed to police patrols who were asked to be aware of the situation and told it was crucial that the offender be apprehended
sentences.zh: 这份报告被分发给巡逻警察，要求他们留意相关情况，并告知必须在罪犯进一步犯案前将其逮捕，这一点至关重要。

sentences.en: before his crimes escalated further.
sentences.zh: 在罪犯的罪行进一步升级之前。

sentences.en: Perth's police had no idea just how far his crimes had already gone.
sentences.zh: 珀斯警方根本不知道他的罪行已经严重到了什么地步。

sentences.en: In early 1963, Perth was experiencing another hot summer.
sentences.zh: 1963年初，珀斯又迎来了一个炎热的夏天。

sentences.en: On Friday, February 15, in the inner city suburb of West Perth, two young women were busy polishing the floors of a flat they'd recently rented together.
sentences.zh: 2月15日星期五，在珀斯市中心的西珀斯郊区，两名年轻女子正忙着擦拭她们刚合租的一间公寓的地板。

sentences.en: 24-year-old Constance
sentences.zh: 24岁的康斯坦斯·马德里尔（Constance Madrill），

sentences.en: Madrill, who went by her middle name Lucy, was a government-employed social worker.
sentences.zh: 她平时用中间名露西（Lucy）称呼自己，是一名政府雇用的社会工作者。

sentences.en: Her housemate Jennifer Hurse worked as a schoolteacher
sentences.zh: 她的室友詹妮弗·赫斯（Jennifer Hurse）是一名学校老师。

sentences.en: The two friends were happy with their new home
sentences.zh: 这两位朋友对她们的新家很满意。

sentences.en: A two bedroom flat inside a large house that had been converted into two apartments
sentences.zh: 这是一栋大房子里的一套两居室公寓，房子被改造成了两套公寓。

sentences.en: Although the area had had issues with prowlers and break-ins
sentences.zh: 尽管该地区曾出现过潜行者和入室盗窃的问题，

sentences.en: The property was situated on a busy road which made them feel safe
sentences.zh: 但由于房产位于一条繁忙的道路上，这让她们感到很安全。

sentences.en: Plus a family of three rented the other flat So there was always someone nearby eye.
sentences.zh: 再加上另一套公寓住着一家三口，所以附近总有人照应。

sentences.en: Lucy felt secure enough there that she kept the back door propped open at all times so that her Siamese cat could come and go.
sentences.zh: 露西觉得那里很安全，所以她总是把后门虚掩着，好让她的暹罗猫能自由进出。

sentences.en: After the two women finished polishing the floors, they each retired to separate rooms to read for the rest of the night.
sentences.zh: 两位女士擦完地板后，各自回到房间，准备在那儿读书度过余下的夜晚。

sentences.en: Between 11 and 11.30pm, Lucy stopped by Jennifer's bedroom to say goodnight, now wearing a short blue nightie.
sentences.zh: 晚上11点到11点半之间，露西穿着一件蓝色短睡裙，去詹妮弗的卧室道了晚安。

sentences.en: She then headed to her own room at the other end of the flat near the back door.
sentences.zh: 随后，她回到了位于公寓另一端、靠近后门的自己房间。

sentences.en: At around 1.30am, Jennifer got up to go to the toilet which was at the rear of the property.
sentences.zh: 凌晨1点半左右，詹妮弗起床去上厕所，厕所在房产的后部。

sentences.en: On her way back to bed, she looked in on Lucy's room.
sentences.zh: 在回卧室的路上，她顺便看了看露西的房间。

sentences.en: Lucy was asleep on her bed, having pulled aside the top sheet and blanket due to the warm night.
sentences.zh: 露西正躺在床上睡觉，因为天气炎热，她掀开了床单和毯子。

sentences.en: Jennifer returned to her room and wasn't disturbed for the rest of the night.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗回到自己的房间，那一晚剩下的时间里没有再被打扰。

sentences.en: Across a lane at the rear of Lucy and Jennifer's flat was a house with a large lawn out the back.
sentences.zh: 在露西和詹妮弗公寓后方的一条小巷对面，有一栋房子，屋后有一个大草坪。

sentences.en: At 6am the morning of Saturday
sentences.zh: 周六早上6点，

sentences.en: February 16, one of the house's residents got up with her young son and the two went to use the outhouse that sat at the back of the property.
sentences.zh: 2月16日，这户人家的一名住户带着她年幼的儿子起床，两人去使用位于房产后方的户外厕所。

sentences.en: Their attention was drawn to a strange bundle that appeared to be lying on the ground near a hill's hoist washing line.
sentences.zh: 他们的注意力被一个奇怪的包裹吸引了，它似乎躺在希尔斯晾衣架（Hill's hoist）附近的地上。

sentences.en: The woman walked closer and realised that she was looking at the naked body of a young woman.
sentences.zh: 那名女子走近一看，意识到自己看到的是一具年轻女性的赤裸尸体。

sentences.en: The body belonged to 24-year-old
sentences.zh: 这具尸体属于24岁的

sentences.en: Lucy Medrill.
sentences.zh: 露西·马德里尔。

sentences.en: An empty whisky bottle was tucked into the crook of her right arm.
sentences.zh: 一个空威士忌酒瓶塞在她右臂的臂弯里。

sentences.en: Police found out that the couple who lived at the house had sat outside the previous night drinking the whiskey together
sentences.zh: 警方发现，住在那栋房子里的一对夫妇前一天晚上曾坐在外面一起喝威士忌。

sentences.en: When they retired to bed at around midnight, one of them had tossed the empty bottle onto the lawn
sentences.zh: 午夜左右他们上床睡觉时，其中一人随手把空瓶子扔到了草坪上。

sentences.en: Lucy's killer had seemingly found it while dumping her body and used it to penetrate her before posing it under her arm
sentences.zh: 露西的杀手在抛尸时似乎发现了这个瓶子，并用它对她进行了性侵，然后将其摆放在她的手臂下。

sentences.en: Lucy's blue nightie lay alongside her
sentences.zh: 露西的蓝色睡裙就放在她身边。

sentences.en: There was a blue bruise across her neck and she had been strangled with a ligature such as a cord.
sentences.zh: 她的脖子上有一块青紫色的淤痕，显然是被绳索之类的东西勒死的。

sentences.en: The killer had raped Lucy post-mortem.
sentences.zh: 凶手在露西死后对她实施了强奸。

sentences.en: The killer had initially dragged Lucy from her home with her heels trailing along the ground before reversing his approach and pulling her across the lawn by her legs.
sentences.zh: 凶手最初拖着露西离开家时，她的脚后跟在地上拖行，随后他改变了方式，拽着她的双腿穿过草坪。

sentences.en: Lucy's bedroom hadn't been ransacked.
sentences.zh: 露西的卧室没有被翻动过。

sentences.en: Her clothes from the day before were lying on the floor near a wall, likely where she'd left them after undressing.
sentences.zh: 她前一天的衣服放在墙边的地板上，很可能是她脱下后随手放那儿的。

sentences.en: Her sheet and blanket were turned back and a dressing gown lay across the foot of her bed.
sentences.zh: 她的床单和毯子被掀开，一件晨衣横在床尾。

sentences.en: Detectives identified what had likely been the murder weapon.
sentences.zh: 侦探们确定了很可能是凶器的东西。

sentences.en: A piece of flecks had been torn from a reading lamp in another room.
sentences.zh: 另一间房间的一盏台灯上被扯下了一块灯罩碎片。

sentences.en: One pound had been stolen from a purse.
sentences.zh: 钱包里的一英镑被偷走了。

sentences.en: The murder of Lucy Madrill called to mind the murders of Penina Berkman and Gillian Brewer several years earlier.
sentences.zh: 露西·马德里尔的谋杀案让人想起了几年前佩妮娜·伯克曼（Penina Berkman）和吉莉安·布鲁尔（Gillian Brewer）的谋杀案。

sentences.en: Although those cases involved stabbing, not strangulation,
sentences.zh: 虽然那些案件涉及刺伤而非勒死，

sentences.en: there was a familiar element in that all involved a young woman brutalised in her own home and left in a state of undress.
sentences.zh: 但有一个共同点，那就是所有受害者都是在自己家中遭到残忍对待，并被弃置在衣不蔽体的状态下。

sentences.en: Lucy's case was almost more shocking due to the horrific way that her body had been violated, then posed out in the open.
sentences.zh: 露西的案件更令人震惊，因为她的尸体遭受了极其可怕的亵渎，然后被摆放在露天处。

sentences.en: Over the past five years, the increase in break-ins and attacks against women at home had made Perth residents far more vigilant about locking doors than they ever had before.
sentences.zh: 在过去的五年里，入室盗窃和针对女性的袭击事件不断增加，这使得珀斯居民比以往任何时候都更警惕锁门。

sentences.en: The murder of Lucy Madrill amplified their wariness.
sentences.zh: 露西·马德里尔的遇害加剧了他们的戒心。

sentences.en: Yet, reports continued to trickle through about night-time break-ins and prowling incidents across the city.
sentences.zh: 然而，关于全市范围内夜间入室盗窃和潜行事件的报告仍不断传来。

sentences.en: In suburbs throughout the north, south and west of Perth, residents found they were missing cash.
sentences.zh: 在珀斯北部、南部和西部的各个郊区，居民们发现自己的现金不翼而飞。

sentences.en: Typically, the burglaries weren't discovered until the thief was long gone, but sometimes he was caught in the act.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，直到窃贼早已逃之夭夭，人们才发现被盗，但有时他也会被当场撞见。

sentences.en: On one occasion, a couple kissing goodnight in Como spotted a man hiding in the bushes watching them.
sentences.zh: 有一次，一对在科莫（Como）道晚安的情侣发现一个男人躲在灌木丛中偷看他们。

sentences.en: Another time, at a house in Applecross, a little girl went into her kitchen and spotted the silhouette of a man.
sentences.zh: 还有一次，在苹果十字区（Applecross）的一户人家，一个小女孩走进厨房，看到了一个男人的剪影。

sentences.en: Is that you, Daddy?
sentences.zh: “是你吗，爸爸？”

sentences.en: she asked as he darted out the back door.
sentences.zh: 她问道，这时那人冲出了后门。

sentences.en: In one encounter, a man came across the prowler in his home.
sentences.zh: 在另一次遭遇中，一名男子在自己家中撞见了潜行者。

sentences.en: He begged the homeowner to let him go, claiming he was only there because he was unemployed and desperate to feed his children.
sentences.zh: 他恳求房主放过他，声称自己只是因为失业，急于养活孩子才来到这里。

sentences.en: Taking pity on who he thought was a desperate burglar, the man gave him some food and let him leave.
sentences.zh: 那名男子同情他，以为他只是个走投无路的窃贼，便给了他一些食物，让他离开了。

sentences.en: One afternoon at 5pm, a woman named Phyllis was in her South Perth kitchen preparing dinner when a strange man walked in.
sentences.zh: 一天下午5点，一位名叫菲利斯（Phyllis）的女士正在南珀斯的厨房里准备晚餐，一个陌生的男人走了进来。

sentences.en: He had dark hair underneath his brimmed hat, was short and carried a leather suitcase.
sentences.zh: 他戴着一顶宽檐帽，帽子下是深色的头发，个子不高，提着一个皮箱。

sentences.en: The man's most notable feature was his cleft lip and palate, a relatively common birth defect in which there is a split in an individual's upper lip.
sentences.zh: 这个男人最显著的特征是唇腭裂，这是一种相对常见的出生缺陷，表现为上唇裂开。

sentences.en: As the man calmly strolled in, he turned and looked blankly at one of Phyllis's sons who was playing nearby.
sentences.zh: 当那个男人从容地走进来时，他转过头，面无表情地看着菲利斯附近玩耍的一个儿子。

sentences.en: Then he put his bag down and started questioning Phyllis, first asking if her husband was home.
sentences.zh: 然后他放下包，开始盘问菲利斯，首先问她丈夫是否在家。

sentences.en: Phyllis said yes, he was sitting in the lounge room.
sentences.zh: 菲利斯说在，他正坐在客厅里。

sentences.en: The man asked how many children the couple had, how old they were, and which schools they attended.
sentences.zh: 那男人问这对夫妇有几个孩子，多大年纪，在哪个学校上学。

sentences.en: Phyllis was terrified, but something told her that the best way to handle the situation was by remaining calm and unfazed.
sentences.zh: 菲利斯吓坏了，但直觉告诉她，处理这种情况的最好方法是保持冷静和镇定。

sentences.en: She politely answered his questions.
sentences.zh: 她礼貌地回答了他的问题。

sentences.en: When she finished, the man picked up his bag again, turned and walked out of the house.
sentences.zh: 问完后，那男人又拿起包，转身走出了房子。

sentences.en: Phyllis rushed to her husband to tell him what had happened and the couple ran to a window.
sentences.zh: 菲利斯冲向丈夫告诉他刚才发生的事，两人跑到窗边。

sentences.en: The man was outside, casually walking down the street and disappearing around the corner like nothing unusual had happened.
sentences.zh: 那男人正在外面，若无其事地走在街上，转过拐角消失了，就像什么都没发生过一样。

sentences.en: Halfway through the year, on Saturday June 15, 1963, 20-year-old Carmel Reid was going to a party.
sentences.zh: 年中，1963年6月15日星期六，20岁的卡梅尔·里德（Carmel Reid）要去参加一个聚会。

sentences.en: Carmel did clerical and statistical work at the University of Western Australia and didn't have many late nights out.
sentences.zh: 卡梅尔在西澳大学从事文书和统计工作，很少有深夜外出的情况。

sentences.en: But tonight was a special occasion.
sentences.zh: 但今晚是一个特殊的日子。

sentences.en: It was the 21st birthday of one of her closest friends.
sentences.zh: 这是她最亲密的朋友之一的21岁生日。

sentences.en: Carmel had a fun night and was driven home at 2.20am by her friend's fiancée, who made sure she got into her home safely.
sentences.zh: 卡梅尔度过了一个愉快的夜晚，凌晨2点20分由朋友的未婚夫开车送回家，他确保她安全进入了家中。

sentences.en: Carmel had moved into her flat in the Netherlands just one month earlier and was living there with two other young women.
sentences.zh: 卡梅尔一个月前刚搬进位于荷兰街（Netherlands）的公寓，和另外两名年轻女子住在一起。

sentences.en: One of them, who Carmel shared a room with, was staying with her boyfriend that night, while the other housemate was already fast asleep by the time Carmel got home.
sentences.zh: 其中一个和卡梅尔同住一室的室友那天晚上和男友在一起，而另一个室友在卡梅尔到家时已经熟睡了。

sentences.en: Carmel got ready for bed and checked all of the windows and doors were locked
sentences.zh: 卡梅尔准备睡觉，检查了所有的窗户和门是否锁好。

sentences.en: There was just one window she didn't check
sentences.zh: 只有一扇窗户她没检查。

sentences.en: It was a small ventilator window located about 5 feet up the lounge room wall
sentences.zh: 那是一扇位于客厅墙上约5英尺高处的小通风窗。

sentences.en: As it only measured 2 feet by 1.5 feet, Carmel figured it was safe to leave slightly open She climbed into bed at 2.45 life.
sentences.zh: 因为它只有2英尺乘1.5英尺大，卡梅尔觉得稍微开着应该没问题。她在凌晨2点45分上床睡觉。

sentences.en: Two hours later, she was abruptly awoken by a rustling sound coming from the dining room.
sentences.zh: 两个小时后，她被餐厅传来的一阵沙沙声惊醒。

sentences.en: Carmel's heart started to pound and she called out, Is anyone there?
sentences.zh: 卡梅尔心跳加速，喊道：“有人吗？”

sentences.en: No reply came and the noise stopped.
sentences.zh: 没有人回答，声音也停止了。

sentences.en: Carmel sat up in bed, listening carefully.
sentences.zh: 卡梅尔坐在床上，仔细聆听。

sentences.en: Then she saw the figure of a man appear in her doorway
sentences.zh: 接着，她看到一个男人的身影出现在门口。

sentences.en: He shone a bright torch into her eyes, blinding her as he walked into the room
sentences.zh: 他用强光手电筒照向她的眼睛，在她走进房间时让她目眩。

sentences.en: Carmel hid under her bedsheets and screamed
sentences.zh: 卡梅尔躲在被子里尖叫起来。

sentences.en: In response, the man stabbed at her chest with a sharp object
sentences.zh: 作为回应，那男人用一件尖锐的物体刺向她的胸口。

sentences.en: Carmel's chest seared with pain and she rolled away to escape the barrage
sentences.zh: 卡梅尔胸口一阵剧痛，她翻身躲避攻击。

sentences.en: She realised she needed to try to escape.
sentences.zh: 她意识到自己必须设法逃脱。

sentences.en: Carmel flung off her sheet and blanket, hoping to hit the man with them, then leapt out of bed and bolted for the door.
sentences.zh: 卡梅尔甩掉床单和毯子，希望能用它们击中那人，然后跳下床，冲向门口。

sentences.en: It was dark and she couldn't see anything.
sentences.zh: 屋里一片漆黑，她什么也看不见。

sentences.en: Suddenly, she felt a sharp, stinging sensation in her face.
sentences.zh: 突然，她感到脸上有一种尖锐的刺痛感。

sentences.en: The man had hit her.
sentences.zh: 那男人打了她。

sentences.en: Then he fled from the flat, dropping the object he'd stabbed Carmel with as he went.
sentences.zh: 随后他逃离了公寓，离开时丢下了刺伤卡梅尔的物体。

sentences.en: It was an umbrella he'd found in her room, and he'd used its still point to jab at her.
sentences.zh: 那是一把他在她房间里发现的雨伞，他用伞尖刺伤了她。

sentences.en: Screaming, Carmel ran to her housemate's room and found her cowering in bed, having overheard the attack.
sentences.zh: 卡梅尔尖叫着跑向室友的房间，发现她正蜷缩在床上，因为听到了袭击声。

sentences.en: Neighbours who heard the commotion called the police.
sentences.zh: 听到骚乱的邻居报了警。

sentences.en: Officers quickly descended on the flat but recovered nothing belonging to the intruder, not even any fingerprints
sentences.zh: 警察迅速赶到公寓，但没有找到任何属于入侵者的东西，甚至连指纹都没有。

sentences.en: The only thing taken from the property was a purse that contained 15 shillings
sentences.zh: 从房产中拿走的唯一东西是一个装有15先令的钱包。

sentences.en: It would turn out that one of the extra police cars patrolling the area due to the frequency of these attacks had passed by Carmel's apartment building just minutes before the assault
sentences.zh: 事实证明，由于此类袭击频发，在附近巡逻的额外警车之一在袭击发生前几分钟刚刚经过卡梅尔的公寓大楼。

sentences.en: The Prowler break-ins weren't the only reason for police issuing additional patrols throughout the relatively small city.
sentences.zh: “潜行者”入室盗窃并不是警方在这个相对较小的城市增加巡逻的唯一原因。

sentences.en: There had been a number of other crimes that had warranted the extra manpower, but no one in law enforcement realised that they were actually all connected.
sentences.zh: 还有许多其他犯罪行为也需要额外的人力，但执法部门没有人意识到它们实际上都是相互关联的。

sentences.en: Almost five years earlier, on the night of Friday, September 12, 1958, a woman named Nell Schneider had been riding her bike home in the southern suburb of Bentley,
sentences.zh: 近五年前，1958年9月12日星期五晚上，一名叫内尔·施耐德（Nell Schneider）的女子在南部的本特利（Bentley）郊区骑自行车回家，

sentences.en: about 8km from Perth's CBD.
sentences.zh: 距离珀斯中央商务区约8公里。

sentences.en: When she was just a few hundred metres from her home, a car suddenly sped up behind her and slammed into her bicycle.
sentences.zh: 当她离家仅几百米时，一辆汽车突然从后面加速，猛地撞向她的自行车。

sentences.en: The bike became stuck to the car's grill as Nell was thrown up in the air.
sentences.zh: 自行车卡在了汽车的格栅上，内尔被抛向空中。

sentences.en: She slammed down on the road head firSt.
sentences.zh: 她头部着地，重重地摔在路上。

sentences.en: As quickly as it had arrived, the car sped away, disappearing into the night.
sentences.zh: 汽车来得快去得也快，加速逃离，消失在夜色中。

sentences.en: Nell was left lying on the bitumen, unconscious in a pool of blood.
sentences.zh: 内尔躺在沥青路上，昏迷不醒，血流满地。

sentences.en: She was found by a passing motorist about 45 minutes later and remained in a coma for two weeks.
sentences.zh: 大约45分钟后，她被一名路过的司机发现，并昏迷了两个星期。

sentences.en: Although she eventually recovered, Nell was diagnosed with chronic post-traumatic temporal lobe epilepsy, which led to her experiencing blackouts and seizures on occasion.
sentences.zh: 虽然最终康复，但内尔被诊断出患有慢性创伤后颞叶癫痫，这导致她偶尔会出现昏厥和癫痫发作。

sentences.en: The car used in the attack was identified as a Ford Consul which had been stolen that same night from a home in Victoria Park.
sentences.zh: 袭击中使用的汽车被确认为一辆福特Consul，是当晚从维多利亚公园（Victoria Park）的一户人家偷来的。

sentences.en: It was found abandoned about half a mile from where Nell was struck.
sentences.zh: 它被发现遗弃在离内尔被撞地点约半英里远的地方。

sentences.en: No fingerprints were recovered from the vehicle.
sentences.zh: 车上没有提取到任何指纹。

sentences.en: Police attributed the theft of the car to joyriders and concluded that they had most likely hit Nell by accident while speeding, then fled in panic.
sentences.zh: 警方将这起偷车案归咎于飙车族，并断定他们很可能是在超速行驶时意外撞到了内尔，然后惊慌逃离。

sentences.en: The incident featured in some newspaper headlines and officers began an intensive search for the culprits.
sentences.zh: 这起事件登上了报纸头条，警官们开始对肇事者进行大规模搜捕。

sentences.en: The investigations continued for some time, but with nothing more to go on, they made no progress.
sentences.zh: 调查持续了一段时间，但由于没有更多线索，进展停滞不前。

sentences.en: What the police didn't know was that the man who would later be dubbed the night caller, had abruptly started committing a new kind of attack.
sentences.zh: 警方不知道的是，那个后来被称为“夜间来电者”的男人，已经突然开始实施一种新的袭击方式。

sentences.en: He'd been breaking into residences and prowling for years, but this was his first violent assault against a stranger.
sentences.zh: 他多年来一直在入室盗窃和潜行，但这是他第一次对陌生人进行暴力袭击。

sentences.en: Three and a half months later, on Saturday December 27, a woman named
sentences.zh: 三个半月后，12月27日星期六，一名叫

sentences.en: Kathy Bellis was walking home from a bus stop late at night after working a shift as a waitress.
sentences.zh: 凯西·贝利斯（Kathy Bellis）的女子在深夜做完服务员的工作后，正从公交车站步行回家。

sentences.en: Cathy lived in Belmont, then a new suburb in the city's east
sentences.zh: 凯西住在贝尔蒙特（Belmont），当时是该市东部的一个新郊区。

sentences.en: There were no streetlights there in 1958 So Cathy pulled out a small torch she kept for occasions when she had to walk their suburbs' unlit streets at night
sentences.zh: 1958年那里没有路灯，所以凯西随身带着一个小手电筒，以备在晚上走郊区没有灯光的街道时使用。

sentences.en: Shining it in front of her, she began to make her way home
sentences.zh: 她照着前方，开始往家走。

sentences.en: It was only two blocks, but Cathy's surroundings were pitch black and very isolated
sentences.zh: 虽然只有两个街区，但凯西周围一片漆黑，非常偏僻。

sentences.en: The street she walked along had no houses, just paddocks and bushland flanking the bitumen road that had only been recently built.
sentences.zh: 她走的那条街没有房子，只有围场和灌木丛，两侧是最近才铺设的沥青路。

sentences.en: Suddenly, a car sped up behind Cathy, engine revving.
sentences.zh: 突然，一辆汽车在凯西身后加速，引擎轰鸣。

sentences.en: It veered straight towards her, striking Cathy hard and throwing her 60 feet across an intersection and into a neighbouring paddock.
sentences.zh: 它径直朝她冲来，猛烈地撞击了凯西，将她抛出60英尺远，穿过一个十字路口，落入旁边的围场。

sentences.en: As Kathy lay in the soft ground of the paddock, she drifted in and out of consciousness
sentences.zh: 当凯西躺在围场松软的土地上时，她意识模糊，时断时续。

sentences.en: Her pelvis and one of her legs seared with pain
sentences.zh: 她的骨盆和一条腿传来剧痛。

sentences.en: Then she saw the face of a man looming above her
sentences.zh: 然后她看到一个男人的脸笼罩在她上方。

sentences.en: Realising it was the car's driver, but unsure whether or not she was hallucinating, she begged
sentences.zh: 意识到这就是肇事司机，但不确定自己是否在产生幻觉，她恳求道：

sentences.en: Don't leave me or I'll die
sentences.zh: “别丢下我，否则我会死的。”

sentences.en: The man laughed, then ran back to his car and sped away.
sentences.zh: 那男人笑了笑，然后跑回车里，加速逃离。

sentences.en: Kathy was discovered by a couple who'd heard her anguished cries and was rushed to the hospital.
sentences.zh: 凯西被一对听到她痛苦呼救声的夫妇发现，并被紧急送往医院。

sentences.en: She had suffered a broken pelvis, two breaks in her leg, a shattered knee, a fracture to the base of her spine and another fracture at the top of her skull.
sentences.zh: 她遭受了骨盆骨折、腿部两处骨折、膝盖粉碎性骨折、脊柱底部骨折以及颅骨顶部骨折。

sentences.en: Over the next year, Kathy had to undergo multiple surgeries and treatments.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的一年里，凯西不得不接受多次手术和治疗。

sentences.en: She would never be able to run again.
sentences.zh: 她再也无法奔跑了。

sentences.en: The car that had struck her turned out to be a ute that was stolen the previous night from the suburb of Como, nine kilometres southwest of
sentences.zh: 撞倒她的那辆车原来是一辆皮卡，是前一天晚上从距离贝尔蒙特九公里西南方向的科莫郊区偷来的。

sentences.en: Belmont.
sentences.zh: 贝尔蒙特。

sentences.en: It was subsequently dumped about five kilometres away from the crime scene.
sentences.zh: 它随后被丢弃在距离犯罪现场约五公里的地方。

sentences.en: More than a year went by with no more mysterious hit and runs, but plenty of other seemingly unrelated
sentences.zh: 一年多过去了，再没有发生神秘的肇事逃逸事件，但在此期间发生了许多其他看似无关的

sentences.en: later crimes were committed during that time, including the murders of Penina Berkman and
sentences.zh: 后来的犯罪案件，包括佩妮娜·伯克曼和

sentences.en: Gillian Brewer.
sentences.zh: 吉莉安·布鲁尔的谋杀案。

sentences.en: Then, almost four months after Gillian's murder, the hit and runs started again.
sentences.zh: 然后，在吉莉安遇害近四个月后，肇事逃逸事件再次发生。

sentences.en: On Saturday April 9, 1960, a 20-year-old named Glennis Peake walked home from a night out at a dance.
sentences.zh: 1960年4月9日星期六，一名叫格莱尼斯·皮克（Glennis Peake）的20岁女孩在参加完舞会后步行回家。

sentences.en: An almost full moon illuminated the night sky as Glennis walked alone in the suburb of
sentences.zh: 格莱尼斯独自走在贝斯沃特（Bayswater）郊区时，一轮近乎满月的圆月照亮了夜空，

sentences.en: Bayswater, 6km northeast of Perth CBD.
sentences.zh: 这里位于珀斯市中心东北方向6公里处。

sentences.en: Glennis kept to the right side of the road so she would be facing any oncoming traffic.
sentences.zh: 格莱尼斯一直靠路右侧行走，这样她就能看清迎面而来的车辆。

sentences.en: It was after midnight and the streets were quiet.
sentences.zh: 当时已过午夜，街道上十分安静。

sentences.en: This area of Perth was sparsely populated with few houses and residents.
sentences.zh: 珀斯的这一带人烟稀少，房屋和居民寥寥无几。

sentences.en: Shortly into her walk, the headlights of a car appeared behind her.
sentences.zh: 她走了没多久，身后就出现了汽车的灯光。

sentences.en: As it passed, Glenys took note of the make, a Holden sedan with a short-looking man behind the wheel.
sentences.zh: 车子经过时，格莱尼斯留意到那是一辆霍顿（Holden）轿车，驾驶座上坐着一个看起来个子矮小的男人。

sentences.en: The car kept her driving and made a right turn further up the road, vanishing into the darkness.
sentences.zh: 车子继续行驶，在前方路口右转，消失在黑暗中。

sentences.en: Glennis kept walking.
sentences.zh: 格莱尼斯继续往前走。

sentences.en: When she reached the street the car had turned into, she noticed that the Holden was parked there with the driver still inside, facing her.
sentences.zh: 当她走到那辆车转入的街道时，发现那辆霍顿轿车正停在那里，司机坐在车里，正对着她。

sentences.en: Glennis was mildly puzzled by this.
sentences.zh: 格莱尼斯对此感到有些困惑。

sentences.en: As it happened, she had to go down the same street as the car to get home, only she was headed in the opposite direction.
sentences.zh: 巧的是，她回家的路正好要经过这条街，只是她走的是相反的方向。

sentences.en: Glenis turned left onto the side street.
sentences.zh: 格莱尼斯左转进入了这条侧街。

sentences.en: She was just one block from her home.
sentences.zh: 她离家只有一个街区了。

sentences.en: She walked in the middle of the street in order to see better as the moon was no longer providing enough light and the bitumen was riddled with potholes.
sentences.zh: 她走在街道中央，因为月光已不足以照明，且沥青路面上坑坑洼洼，这样能看得更清楚些。

sentences.en: All of a sudden, Glenis heard the roar of an engine as a car drove up behind her.
sentences.zh: 突然，格莱尼斯听到身后传来一阵引擎轰鸣声，一辆车开了过来。

sentences.en: It was the same Holden as before and it had veered into the wrong side of the road in order to head straight towards her.
sentences.zh: 正是之前那辆霍顿轿车，它驶入了道路的错误一侧，径直朝她冲来。

sentences.en: Glennis tried to jump out of the way, but the car hit her left hip as the driver struck Glennis from an angle so as to avoid a nearby tree.
sentences.zh: 格莱尼斯试图跳开躲避，但司机为了避开附近的一棵树，从侧面撞上了她的左髋部。

sentences.en: She was tossed over the bonnet, cutting her face open on one of the windscreen wipers in the process.
sentences.zh: 她被撞得飞过引擎盖，过程中脸部被其中一个雨刮器割伤。

sentences.en: Glennis landed in some gravel and a broken glass by the side of the road.
sentences.zh: 格莱尼斯摔在路边的碎石和碎玻璃堆里。

sentences.en: She lay there, shocked but conscious, as the car drove away.
sentences.zh: 她躺在那里，虽然惊魂未定但意识清醒，看着车子开走了。

sentences.en: She knew the driver had run her down deliberately.
sentences.zh: 她知道司机是蓄意撞她的。

sentences.en: Terrified he'd come back to finish the job, she scrambled to her feet and stumbled home.
sentences.zh: 她害怕对方会回来补刀，于是挣扎着爬起来，跌跌撞撞地跑回了家。

sentences.en: Glennis was rushed to hospital where an assessment revealed that she hadn't broken any bones but she had a number of wounds that required stitches.
sentences.zh: 格莱尼斯被紧急送往医院，检查显示她没有骨折，但身上有多处伤口需要缝合。

sentences.en: Police officers paid a visit to the scene of the hit-and-run.
sentences.zh: 警察随后走访了这起肇事逃逸现场。

sentences.en: Although Glenys had said she'd left her handbag lying there, it was missing.
sentences.zh: 尽管格莱尼斯说她把手提包落在了那里，但包不见了。

sentences.en: About a hundred metres from there was a clearly abandoned car.
sentences.zh: 在离那儿约一百米的地方，有一辆明显被遗弃的汽车。

sentences.en: It was a Holden sedan with the keys in the ignition.
sentences.zh: 那是一辆霍顿轿车，钥匙还插在点火开关上。

sentences.en: It had been stolen from the garage of a used car salesman who'd taken the
sentences.zh: 这辆车是从一名二手车推销员的车库里偷来的，他周末刚把这辆

sentences.en: Holden home from the dealership for the weekend.
sentences.zh: 霍顿轿车从车行开回家。

sentences.en: The attacker's fingerprints were nowhere to be found.
sentences.zh: 车上没有发现袭击者的指纹。

sentences.en: Just after 11pm on Friday May 13, one month after Glenys Peake's hit and run, 18-year-old
sentences.zh: 1960年5月13日星期五晚上11点刚过，在格莱尼斯·皮克遭遇肇事逃逸一个月后，18岁的

sentences.en: Jill Connell was walking home from a bus stop in Belmont when she was deliberately run down by a driver in a green Morris Minor sedan.
sentences.zh: 吉尔·康奈尔（Jill Connell）在贝尔蒙特（Belmont）从公交车站步行回家时，被一名驾驶绿色莫里斯米诺（Morris Minor）轿车的司机蓄意撞倒。

sentences.en: After being thrown onto the bonnet, Jill fell to the ground, sobbing.
sentences.zh: 吉尔被撞飞到引擎盖上后摔在地上，啜泣不止。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the Morris Minor had gotten stuck in some sand that bordered the road.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，那辆莫里斯米诺轿车陷入了路边的沙地里。

sentences.en: The driver jumped out and ran away, laughing.
sentences.zh: 司机跳下车，大笑着逃跑了。

sentences.en: It was an hour before Jill was found lying unconscious and bleeding behind the abandoned vehicle.
sentences.zh: 过了一个小时，吉尔才被发现昏迷不醒地躺在废弃车辆后方，身上带着血迹。

sentences.en: She later underwent emergency surgery.
sentences.zh: 她随后接受了紧急手术。

sentences.en: The green Morris Minor had been reported stolen from a home in the South Perth suburb of Como two hours earlier.
sentences.zh: 这辆绿色莫里斯米诺轿车在两小时前被报从南珀斯科莫（Como）郊区的一户人家中被盗。

sentences.en: The prints of the car thief weren't found anywhere on or in the vehicle.
sentences.zh: 在车内外的任何地方都没有发现偷车贼的指纹。

sentences.en: Exactly one week after the attack on Jill Connell, an 18-year-old named Georgina Pittman spent a fun night out dancing.
sentences.zh: 在袭击吉尔·康奈尔事件发生整整一周后，一名叫乔治娜·皮特曼（Georgina Pittman）的18岁女孩度过了一个愉快的夜晚。

sentences.en: She caught the 11.35pm train home where she struck up a conversation with
sentences.zh: 她搭乘晚上11点35分的火车回家，途中与

sentences.en: 16-year-old Maureen Rogers and her 12-year-old cousin Therese Zagami, who had just attended a concert.
sentences.zh: 16岁的莫琳·罗杰斯（Maureen Rogers）和她12岁的表妹特蕾莎·扎加米（Therese Zagami）聊了起来，她们刚看完一场音乐会。

sentences.en: It was raining heavily when they disembarked at Queen's Park Station in South
sentences.zh: 当她们在南珀斯的皇后公园车站（Queen's Park Station）下车时，外面正下着大雨，

sentences.en: Perth and there were no taxis waiting at the cab rank outside.
sentences.zh: 出租车候车点没有车。

sentences.en: The only car in the vicinity was an expensive-looking new Chrysler Royal which was white with a red stripe and had Victorian license plates.
sentences.zh: 附近唯一的一辆车是一辆看起来很昂贵的新款克莱斯勒皇家（Chrysler Royal）轿车，车身白色带红色条纹，挂着维多利亚州的车牌。

sentences.en: A man sat behind the wheel, wearing a brimmed hat.
sentences.zh: 一名戴着宽檐帽的男子坐在驾驶座上。

sentences.en: The three girls decided to walk home.
sentences.zh: 三个女孩决定步行回家。

sentences.en: Maureen and Georgina huddled together under Maureen's umbrella while Teresa walked slightly ahead under her own umbrella.
sentences.zh: 莫琳和乔治娜挤在莫琳的伞下，而特蕾莎则撑着自己的伞走在稍前面一点。

sentences.en: They were making their way up George Street, an isolated road bordered by large paddocks, a few houses, and a poultry farm.
sentences.zh: 她们沿着乔治街（George Street）走，这是一条偏僻的路，两旁是大片的围场、几栋房子和一个养鸡场。

sentences.en: Suddenly, a car zoomed past them at high speed.
sentences.zh: 突然，一辆车高速从她们身边疾驰而过。

sentences.en: Gee, this guy's an idiot, Maureen said
sentences.zh: “天哪，这人是个白痴，”莫琳说。

sentences.en: It was the same Chrysler that had been parked at the train station
sentences.zh: 正是之前停在火车站的那辆克莱斯勒。

sentences.en: The driver then did a U-turn and sped back past the girls in the other direction before pulling into a side street behind them
sentences.zh: 司机随后掉头，从另一个方向疾驰经过女孩们，然后拐进了她们身后的一条侧街。

sentences.en: The three girls kept walking
sentences.zh: 三个女孩继续往前走。

sentences.en: It was quiet and dark as they reached an area of the road where there were no houses only empty paddocks on either side.
sentences.zh: 当她们走到路上一段没有房屋、两侧只有空围场的地段时，四周一片漆黑寂静。

sentences.en: The still night air was abruptly broken by a roaring sound.
sentences.zh: 寂静的夜空突然被一阵轰鸣声打破。

sentences.en: Georgina turned around and saw headlights approaching.
sentences.zh: 乔治娜回过头，看到车灯正逼近过来。

sentences.en: It was the Chrysler veering across the road towards them.
sentences.zh: 正是那辆克莱斯勒，它横穿马路朝她们冲来。

sentences.en: 12-year-old Therese, who was walking right at the road's edge, also spun around.
sentences.zh: 走在路边的12岁女孩特蕾莎也转过身来。

sentences.en: Look out, she cried, before jumping out of the car's path.
sentences.zh: “小心！”她大喊一声，随即跳出了车子的行驶路线。

sentences.en: It barely missed her and Therese felt a gust of wind hit her as the vehicle passed.
sentences.zh: 车子擦着她飞驰而过，特蕾莎感到一阵风刮过。

sentences.en: Then it struck Georgina and Maureen head on.
sentences.zh: 紧接着，车子正面撞上了乔治娜和莫琳。

sentences.en: Georgina was thrown into the ditch that ran alongside the road.
sentences.zh: 乔治娜被撞进了路边的沟里。

sentences.en: Maureen bore the brunt of the impact as the vehicle hit her left leg and broke both of its major bones.
sentences.zh: 莫琳承受了撞击的主要力量，车子撞断了她左腿的两根主要骨头。

sentences.en: The force of the hit had also broken the car's radiator grill.
sentences.zh: 撞击的力度也撞坏了汽车的散热器格栅。

sentences.en: Maureen was tossed onto the bonnet and stayed there, bleeding profusely as the driver continued to speed ahead.
sentences.zh: 莫琳被抛到引擎盖上，血流不止，而司机继续加速前行。

sentences.en: He made a sharp turn as they reached an intersection about 100 metres up the road and Maureen finally fell from the bonnet onto the ground.
sentences.zh: 当她们到达前方约100米处的十字路口时，他猛地转弯，莫琳终于从引擎盖上摔到了地上。

sentences.en: Georgina Pittman was in a daze down the road looking for her shoes.
sentences.zh: 乔治娜·皮特曼神志恍惚地走在路上，寻找她的鞋子。

sentences.en: She had no idea what had happened.
sentences.zh: 她根本不知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: She only knew that her feet were bare for some reason.
sentences.zh: 她只知道不知为何自己赤着脚。

sentences.en: Georgina didn't realise that her dress was also torn and she'd sustained deep cuts to her head and back which were now bleeding.
sentences.zh: 乔治娜没意识到自己的裙子也破了，头部和背部受了深可见骨的伤，正在流血。

sentences.en: Mum, mum, Georgina desperately called as she walked in circles.
sentences.zh: “妈妈，妈妈，”乔治娜绝望地呼喊着，在原地转圈。

sentences.en: Therese Zagami had escaped injury but was terrified that the driver would return.
sentences.zh: 特蕾莎·扎加米没有受伤，但她非常害怕司机折返。

sentences.en: She began running towards home, which was up ahead in the direction they'd been walking.
sentences.zh: 她开始朝家的方向跑去，家就在她们刚才行进的前方。

sentences.en: Therese stayed low and away from the road to hide from their attacker.
sentences.zh: 特蕾莎压低身子，远离马路，以躲避袭击者。

sentences.en: As she reached the top of the hill, she came across her cousin Maureen lying bleeding in the middle of the road.
sentences.zh: 当她爬上山坡时，发现表姐莫琳正躺在马路中央流血。

sentences.en: Therese ran over to her, asking,
sentences.zh: 特蕾莎跑过去问她：

sentences.en: Maureen, are you alright?
sentences.zh: “莫琳，你还好吗？”

sentences.en: There was no answer.
sentences.zh: 没有回应。

sentences.en: Realising her cousin must be dead, Therese's fear intensified and she kept running towards home.
sentences.zh: 意识到表姐可能已经死了，特蕾莎的恐惧加剧，继续向家跑去，

sentences.en: which was only about another 100 metres away.
sentences.zh: 离家只有约100米远了。

sentences.en: Therese's parents were out, but her aunt lived next door.
sentences.zh: 特蕾莎的父母不在家，但她的姨妈住在隔壁。

sentences.en: Therese banged on her front door, screaming.
sentences.zh: 特蕾莎拼命敲门，尖叫着。

sentences.en: It was deliberate.
sentences.zh: “是蓄意的。”

sentences.en: It was deliberate.
sentences.zh: “是蓄意的。”

sentences.en: Just as Therese was raising the alarm, two patrol officers passing through the area stumbled across Maureen's body.
sentences.zh: 就在特蕾莎报警时，两名巡逻警察经过该地区，偶然发现了莫琳的身体。

sentences.en: She still had a pulse.
sentences.zh: 她还有脉搏。

sentences.en: They soon found Georgina as well.
sentences.zh: 他们很快也找到了乔治娜。

sentences.en: The girls were rushed to hospital.
sentences.zh: 女孩们被紧急送往医院。

sentences.en: Maureen needed emergency surgery on her left leg.
sentences.zh: 莫琳的左腿需要进行紧急手术。

sentences.en: Her left cheekbone was also fractured and she was entirely covered in bruises.
sentences.zh: 她的左颧骨也骨折了，全身布满了淤青。

sentences.en: Georgina had a concussion and several deep gashes that needed stitches.
sentences.zh: 乔治娜脑震荡，身上有几处深伤口需要缝合。

sentences.en: All three girls were left with severe mental and emotional trauma.
sentences.zh: 三个女孩都留下了严重的心理和情感创伤。

sentences.en: At the scene of the crime, police recovered a small piece of the car's radiator grill that had been broken during the hit and run
sentences.zh: 在犯罪现场，警方找到了一小块在肇事逃逸中撞碎的汽车散热器格栅碎片。

sentences.en: The Chrysler itself was found just before 7 the following morning of Saturday, May 21
sentences.zh: 那辆克莱斯勒本身在次日，即5月21日星期六早上7点前被发现。

sentences.en: It had been dumped near a railway line in the suburb of East Victoria Park, about 5km away
sentences.zh: 它被丢弃在约5公里外东维多利亚公园（East Victoria Park）郊区的一条铁路线附近。

sentences.en: There was damage to the top and left side of the bonnet and the broken radiator grill matched the piece found at the scene.
sentences.zh: 引擎盖顶部和左侧有损坏，破碎的散热器格栅与现场发现的碎片相吻合。

sentences.en: The Chrysler had been stolen from a 60-year-old man who had driven from Melbourne to Perth to visit his adult son and his family.
sentences.zh: 这辆克莱斯勒是从一名60岁男子那里偷来的，他从墨尔本开车到珀斯探望成年的儿子和家人。

sentences.en: The family had discovered the theft the previous night and immediately reported it to the police.
sentences.zh: 这家人在前一天晚上发现车被盗，并立即向警方报了案。

sentences.en: No fingerprints belonging to the thief were found on either the interior or exterior of the vehicle.
sentences.zh: 在车内外的任何地方都没有发现属于窃贼的指纹。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, both the police and Perth's media were starting to notice the pattern of deliberate hit and runs over the past month and a half.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，警方和珀斯媒体开始注意到过去一个半月里发生的蓄意肇事逃逸模式。

sentences.en: A number of detectives and traffic police were assigned to the case, with a growing theory emerging that one man could be behind all of the crimes.
sentences.zh: 多名侦探和交警被指派负责此案，一种日益增长的理论认为，可能是一个人制造了所有这些罪行。

sentences.en: Articles about the latest incident ran on the front page of the weekend papers, with one headline asking,
sentences.zh: 关于最新事件的文章登上了周末报纸的头版，其中一个标题问道：

sentences.en: Is a hit-run maniac on the loose?
sentences.zh: “肇事逃逸狂魔在逃？”

sentences.en: The story read in part, quote,
sentences.zh: 报道中写道，引述：

sentences.en: Three girls were apparently deliberately run down by a powerful stolen car early today.
sentences.zh: “今天早些时候，三名女孩显然被一辆强力失窃车辆蓄意撞倒。”

sentences.en: This climaxed what may be a series of cold-blooded attempts to kill or main pedestrians.
sentences.zh: “这可能是一系列冷血杀害或残害行人的企图达到了高潮。”

sentences.en: Three times in the past six weeks, each time in the weekend, girls had been injured by a stolen hit-run car, later abandoned, in different suburbs.
sentences.zh: “在过去六周内，三次发生在周末，女孩们在不同的郊区被一辆失窃的肇事逃逸车辆撞伤，车辆随后被遗弃。”

sentences.en: Detectives tracked down known car thieves and questioned them extensively.
sentences.zh: 侦探们追踪并详细审问了已知的偷车贼。

sentences.en: Due to the hit-and-runs always taking place on a Friday or Saturday night, special patrols were implemented on those days between 5pm and 1am.
sentences.zh: 由于肇事逃逸总是发生在周五或周六晚上，警方在这些天的下午5点到凌晨1点实施了特别巡逻。

sentences.en: In a report about the case, one detective sergeant concluded that he was convinced that one perpetrator was responsible for all three of the attacks, while acknowledging that
sentences.zh: 在一份关于此案的报告中，一名侦探警长总结说，他确信是一名肇事者制造了所有三起袭击，同时也承认

sentences.en: he had no evidence.
sentences.zh: 他没有任何证据。

sentences.en: Without fingerprints or anything else belonging to the perpetrator at any of the scenes, there was no way to prove their theory.
sentences.zh: 由于在任何现场都没有发现指纹或属于肇事者的其他物品，他们无法证明这一理论。

sentences.en: No connection was made to the prowler breaking into homes across the city, even though he also stole cars, struck on weekend
sentences.zh: 这与全市范围内闯入民宅的潜行者没有建立任何联系，尽管他也偷车、在周末

sentences.en: and nights, targeted random victims, and never left a single fingerprint.
sentences.zh: 和夜间作案、随机选择受害者，且从未留下过一枚指纹。

sentences.en: The hit and run stopped after the attack against Georgina Pittman, Maureen Rogers, and Therese Zagami.
sentences.zh: 在针对乔治娜·皮特曼、莫琳·罗杰斯和特蕾莎·扎加米的袭击之后，肇事逃逸事件停止了。

sentences.en: Months passed, then years.
sentences.zh: 几个月过去了，然后是几年。

sentences.en: But the night caller never ceased his crimes, and in the beginning of 1963, he would launch another shocking attack using a new kind of stolen weapon.
sentences.zh: 但那个夜间出没的凶手从未停止犯罪，1963年初，他将使用一种新的失窃武器发动另一起令人震惊的袭击。

sentences.en: Australia Day is Australia's official national day, observed annually on January 26.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚日是澳大利亚的官方国庆日，每年1月26日举行。

sentences.en: There is some controversy around this date as it was chosen to mark the landing of the first British colonists in 1788.
sentences.zh: 这个日期存在争议，因为它标志着1788年第一批英国殖民者登陆的日子。

sentences.en: In recent years, there has been much debate as to whether it should be changed.
sentences.zh: 近年来，关于是否应该更改日期引发了许多争论。

sentences.en: For many residents of Perth in 1963, Australia Day just signified another long weekend and a chance to enjoy the summer.
sentences.zh: 对于1963年许多珀斯居民来说，澳大利亚日只是意味着又一个长周末，一个享受夏日的机会。

sentences.en: The holiday fell on a Saturday that year, so Australians would have a three-day weekend with no work on Monday.
sentences.zh: 那年的节日恰逢星期六，所以澳大利亚人将有一个为期三天的周末，周一不用上班。

sentences.en: Saturday January 26 was a hot night and Perth was a bus, with many out drinking and celebrating.
sentences.zh: 1月26日星期六是一个炎热的夜晚，珀斯非常热闹，许多人外出饮酒庆祝。

sentences.en: The Ocean Beach Hotel, a pub that sat across from the beach in North Cottesloe, was packed.
sentences.zh: 海洋海滩酒店（Ocean Beach Hotel）是一家位于北科特斯洛（North Cottesloe）海滩对面的酒吧，里面挤满了人。

sentences.en: Bartender Rowena Reeves worked at the hotel until closing, then went to a restaurant with three friends.
sentences.zh: 酒保罗薇娜·里夫斯（Rowena Reeves）在酒店工作到打烊，然后和三个朋友去了一家餐馆。

sentences.en: Afterwards, at around 2am, the group of four drove to a quiet spot overlooking the ocean to chat and have a few more drinks.
sentences.zh: 之后，大约凌晨2点，四人开车到一个可以俯瞰大海的僻静地方聊天，又喝了几杯。

sentences.en: However, an argument broke out between two members of the group who were a couple.
sentences.zh: 然而，同行的两人（一对情侣）之间发生了争执。

sentences.en: They soon left, leaving Rowena alone in the car with her friend Nick AuguSt. Rowena sat in the car's back seat drinking pink champagne while Nick sat behind the wheel.
sentences.zh: 他们很快离开了，留下罗薇娜和她的朋友尼克·奥古斯特（Nick August）独自在车里。罗薇娜坐在后座喝着粉红香槟，尼克坐在驾驶座上。

sentences.en: As Rowena sipped her drink, she noticed a man standing less than eight metres away, staring at them.
sentences.zh: 罗薇娜喝着酒时，注意到一个男人站在不到八米远的地方盯着他们。

sentences.en: She pointed him out to Nick
sentences.zh: 她指给尼克看。

sentences.en: Nick was married and suspected the stranger had been sent by his wife to spy on him
sentences.zh: 尼克已婚，怀疑这个陌生人是他妻子派来监视他的。

sentences.en: Angered, Nick tossed an empty beer bottle at the man through the open window and yelled at him to piss off
sentences.zh: 尼克很生气，通过敞开的车窗向那人扔了一个空啤酒瓶，并大声叫他滚开。

sentences.en: As the bottle rolled down the street, Rowena saw the man lift up something
sentences.zh: 当瓶子滚到街上时，罗薇娜看到那人举起了什么东西。

sentences.en: Look out, he's got a gun, she cried, while pushing Nick's head down so it wouldn't be visible from outside
sentences.zh: “小心，他有枪！”她尖叫着，同时把尼克的头往下按，以免从外面看到他。

sentences.en: The man fired a rifle
sentences.zh: 那人开了一枪。

sentences.en: Nick felt a sudden pain in his neck
sentences.zh: 尼克感到脖子一阵剧痛。

sentences.en: He's got me, he stated, before hurriedly starting the car's engine and speeding away
sentences.zh: “他打中我了，”他说着，急忙发动引擎疾驰而去。

sentences.en: The man with the rifle fired once again at the retreating vehicle, but missed
sentences.zh: 持枪男子又向撤退的车辆开了一枪，但没打中。

sentences.en: In the backseat of the car, Rowena was bleeding badly.
sentences.zh: 在车后座，罗薇娜流血不止。

sentences.en: The bullet that had grazed Nick's neck had then struck her wrist, shattering it.
sentences.zh: 那颗擦伤尼克脖子的子弹随后击中了她的手腕，将其击碎。

sentences.en: Nick sped towards the nearest hospital, which was in the port city of Fremantle, about 8km south.
sentences.zh: 尼克加速驶向最近的医院，位于约8公里南部的港口城市弗里曼特尔（Fremantle）。

sentences.en: The pair were admitted for treatment, and at 3.30am medical staff notified the police that they had two shooting victims who needed to be interviewed.
sentences.zh: 两人被收治，凌晨3点30分，医务人员通知警方，他们有两名需要接受询问的枪击受害者。

sentences.en: It was almost half an hour later when the doorbell rang at a house on Louise Street in Netherlands,
sentences.zh: 近半小时后，荷兰路（Louise Street）的一所房子门铃响了，

sentences.en: five and a half kilometres east of where Rowena Reeves and Nick August were attacked.
sentences.zh: 距离罗薇娜·里夫斯和尼克·奥古斯特遇袭地点东面五点五公里处。

sentences.en: The house was a single-storey brick residence, home to the Wormsley family.
sentences.zh: 这是一栋单层砖房，是沃姆斯利（Wormsley）一家的住所。

sentences.en: Daughter Sandra Wormsley was woken by the doorbell, which rang twice in quick succession.
sentences.zh: 女儿桑德拉·沃姆斯利（Sandra Wormsley）被门铃声惊醒，门铃连续响了两声。

sentences.en: Sandra heard the familiar footsteps of her father, George Wormsley, walking towards the front door.
sentences.zh: 桑德拉听到了父亲乔治·沃姆斯利（George Wormsley）熟悉的脚步声，正朝前门走去。

sentences.en: As he opened the door, a loud gunshot rang out.
sentences.zh: 随着他打开门，一声响亮的枪声响起。

sentences.en: Dad, Sandra screamed, jumping out of bed and running to the front door.
sentences.zh: “爸爸！”桑德拉尖叫着，从床上跳起来跑向大门。

sentences.en: She was joined by her mother.
sentences.zh: 她的母亲也赶了过来。

sentences.en: To their horror, George lay in the doorway, his hair soaked with blood and his eyes glazed.
sentences.zh: 令她们惊恐的是，乔治倒在门口，头发被血浸透，双眼失神。

sentences.en: Clearly visible in his forehead was a bullet hole.
sentences.zh: 他的额头上清晰可见一个弹孔。

sentences.en: There was no sign of the shooter.
sentences.zh: 现场没有枪手的踪迹。

sentences.en: Sandra ran to the kitchen where the family's telephone was located and called the police and a nearby neighbour.
sentences.zh: 桑德拉跑到厨房，那里有家里的电话，她报了警并联系了一位邻居。

sentences.en: Then she returned to her father's body and tried to comfort her devastated mother.
sentences.zh: 然后她回到父亲的尸体旁，试图安慰悲痛欲绝的母亲。

sentences.en: The pair were in complete shock.
sentences.zh: 两人都处于极度震惊之中。

sentences.en: It made no sense that their entire world could have been turned upside down in a split second.
sentences.zh: 她们无法理解，整个世界怎么会在一瞬间天翻地覆。

sentences.en: George was a loving, warm man.
sentences.zh: 乔治是一个充满爱心、待人热忱的人。

sentences.en: It made no sense that anyone would want to harm him.
sentences.zh: 想不通为什么会有人想要伤害他。

sentences.en: Fifteen minutes later, and just one block over on Vincent Street, a young man named Scott McWilliam was woken from his sleep by the sound of shouting.
sentences.zh: 十五分钟后，在文森特街区隔壁，一个名叫斯科特·麦克威廉的年轻人被叫喊声惊醒。

sentences.en: Scott was staying at a boarding house that was home to a number of young people, and the yelling was coming from another resident, his landlady's niece, Pauline.
sentences.zh: 斯科特住在一间寄宿公寓里，那里住着许多年轻人，喊叫声来自另一位住户，也就是房东的侄女宝琳。

sentences.en: She was saying that there was something wrong with John Sturkey, an 18-year-old boarder who was leaving Perth the following week to study veterinary medicine in Brisbane.
sentences.zh: 她说约翰·斯塔基出事了，那是个18岁的寄宿生，下周就要离开珀斯去布里斯班学习兽医。

sentences.en: Scott got up to see what was wrong.
sentences.zh: 斯科特起身去查看发生了什么事。

sentences.en: John had been sleeping outside on a single bed on the back veranda where the air was cooler at night.
sentences.zh: 约翰一直睡在后阳台的一张单人床上，那里的空气在晚上更凉爽。

sentences.en: Flicking on the veranda's light switch, Scott saw there was an enormous pool of blood on the concrete flooring next to John's bed
sentences.zh: 斯科特打开阳台的灯，看到约翰床边的水泥地上有一大滩血迹。

sentences.en: John was in the bed, with blood soaked into the linen around his head
sentences.zh: 约翰躺在床上，头部的床单被血浸透了。

sentences.en: He was making a gurgling sound
sentences.zh: 他发出咕噜咕噜的声音。

sentences.en: Scott and another boarder rushed forward to lift John's head up so he could breathe
sentences.zh: 斯科特和另一位住客冲上前去抬起约翰的头，好让他呼吸。

sentences.en: There was a gunshot visible at the top of his forehead
sentences.zh: 他的额头上方有一个清晰的枪伤。

sentences.en: Pauline phoned for an ambulance, then called the police
sentences.zh: 宝琳打了救护车电话，随后报了警。

sentences.en: Officers told Pauline that everyone at the residence was to stay inside and keep low beneath the windows
sentences.zh: 警察告诉宝琳，住所里的所有人都要待在室内，并蹲在窗户下方。

sentences.en: There was somebody going around the neighbourhood shooting people
sentences.zh: 有人正在附近四处射击路人。

sentences.en: Both George Wormsley and John Sturkey were rushed in separate ambulances to Royal Perth Hospital, arriving within five minutes of one another
sentences.zh: 乔治·沃姆斯利和约翰·斯塔基分别被送往皇家珀斯医院，两人抵达的时间相差不到五分钟。

sentences.en: John was pronounced dead three minutes after arrival
sentences.zh: 约翰在抵达三分钟后被宣告死亡。

sentences.en: George Wormsley was given emergency surgery but died about an hour and a half later
sentences.zh: 乔治·沃姆斯利接受了紧急手术，但在一个半小时后去世。

sentences.en: Police were still processing both crime scenes and had just been notified of the two deaths When another call came in
sentences.zh: 警方仍在处理两个犯罪现场，刚接到两起死亡报告，又接到了另一个电话。

sentences.en: Len Barth wasn't initially worried when his friend Brian Weir didn't show up for a scheduled surf rescue boat training session on Sunday morning.
sentences.zh: 周日上午，当朋友布莱恩·威尔没有出现在预定的冲浪救生艇训练课程时，莱恩·巴斯起初并不担心。

sentences.en: 29-year-old Brian, whose day job was as an accountant, was often late.
sentences.zh: 29岁的布莱恩是一名会计，平时经常迟到。

sentences.en: But after waiting around for more than two hours, Len decided to go check on Brian.
sentences.zh: 但在等待了两个多小时后，莱恩决定去看看布莱恩的情况。

sentences.en: He drove the short distance from the Swambourn, Netherlands Surf Life Saving Club to Brian's home.
sentences.zh: 他开车从斯旺伯恩冲浪救生俱乐部出发，前往不远处的布莱恩家。

sentences.en: Brian lived in a first floor apartment in a block of four on Broome Street,
sentences.zh: 布莱恩住在布鲁姆街一栋四户公寓楼的二楼。

sentences.en: Cottesloe.
sentences.zh: 位于科特斯洛。

sentences.en: When Len arrived, he saw that the door that led from Brian's bedroom to the apartment's balcony was open.
sentences.zh: 莱恩到达时，看到从布莱恩卧室通往阳台的门开着。

sentences.en: Len clambered up to the balcony and walked in.
sentences.zh: 莱恩爬上阳台走了进去。

sentences.en: Brian was still in bed, but the scene was all wrong.
sentences.zh: 布莱恩还在床上，但现场的情况完全不对劲。

sentences.en: His head was hanging over one side and there was blood everywhere.
sentences.zh: 他的头垂在一侧，到处都是血。

sentences.en: Brian felt stiff and his complexion was grey, but Len could still hear him faintly breathing.
sentences.zh: 布莱恩身体僵硬，脸色灰白，但莱恩仍能听到他微弱的呼吸声。

sentences.en: Len was horrified.
sentences.zh: 莱恩惊恐万分。

sentences.en: It looked as though Brian had been in a violent fight.
sentences.zh: 看起来布莱恩像是经历了一场激烈的搏斗。

sentences.en: Len raced back to the Surf Lifesaving Club and told his teammates what he'd found.
sentences.zh: 莱恩跑回冲浪救生俱乐部，告诉队友他发现了什么。

sentences.en: One of them had heard news reports about the overnight shootings in nearby Netherlands and they all raced back to Brian's flat together.
sentences.zh: 其中一人听到了关于昨晚在附近内德兰兹发生枪击案的新闻报道，他们一起赶回了布莱恩的公寓。

sentences.en: When they looked more closely at their friend, they saw that the top left side of his head was completely gone.
sentences.zh: 当他们仔细观察朋友时，发现他头部的左上方已经完全缺失了。

sentences.en: Brian was rushed to the hospital and underwent emergency surgery.
sentences.zh: 布莱恩被紧急送往医院并接受了手术。

sentences.en: A bullet was found lodged in the left temporal lobe of Brian's brain, with fragments scattered throughout.
sentences.zh: 一颗子弹被发现卡在布莱恩大脑的左颞叶中，碎片散布在各处。

sentences.en: Surgeons had to remove these foreign objects, as well as splintered pieces of bone and much of Brian's damaged brain matter.
sentences.zh: 外科医生不得不取出这些异物，以及破碎的骨片和布莱恩受损的大部分脑组织。

sentences.en: Brian survived the surgery but remained in a coma.
sentences.zh: 布莱恩挺过了手术，但陷入了昏迷。

sentences.en: He stayed in his coma for six months, with police constantly keeping guard.
sentences.zh: 他在昏迷中躺了六个月，警方一直守在旁边。

sentences.en: When Brian eventually regained consciousness, he was unable to speak, walk or move his arMs.
sentences.zh: 当布莱恩最终恢复意识时，他无法说话、走路或移动手臂。

sentences.en: His right side was entirely paralysed.
sentences.zh: 他的右侧身体完全瘫痪。

sentences.en: He had lost sight in one eye and hearing in one ear.
sentences.zh: 他的一只眼睛失明，一只耳朵失聪。

sentences.en: The severe brain damage also caused him to have epileptic fits
sentences.zh: 严重的脑损伤还导致他患上了癫痫。

sentences.en: Despite being just 29 years old, Brian had to be moved into an aged care nursing home due to requiring round-the-clock care
sentences.zh: 尽管年仅29岁，布莱恩还是因为需要全天候护理而被送进了养老院。

sentences.en: On December 19, 1965, almost three years after the attack, Brian Weird died as a result of his injuries
sentences.zh: 1965年12月19日，在袭击发生近三年后，布莱恩·威尔因伤势过重去世。

sentences.en: The Australia Day attacks dominated newspaper headlines in the immediate aftermath of the shootings.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚日袭击事件在枪击案发生后的第一时间占据了报纸头条。

sentences.en: Articles provided a timeline of the attacks, which was pieced together by the police.
sentences.zh: 文章提供了由警方拼凑出的袭击时间线。

sentences.en: Rowena Reeves and Nick August had been the shooter's first victiMs.
sentences.zh: 罗威娜·里夫斯和尼克·奥古斯特是枪手的首批受害者。

sentences.en: Both had survived after sustaining injuries from the same bullet.
sentences.zh: 两人在被同一颗子弹击伤后幸存了下来。

sentences.en: Police had found a spent casing at the scene of the crime.
sentences.zh: 警方在犯罪现场发现了一个弹壳。

sentences.en: The shooter had then walked around the corner and stopped outside Brian Weir's home.
sentences.zh: 枪手随后绕过街角，停在布莱恩·威尔家门外。

sentences.en: He'd climbed up the first floor balcony where Brian had left the door open.
sentences.zh: 他爬上了布莱恩没关门的二楼阳台。

sentences.en: Brian had dragged his bed right up to the door, sleeping with his head towards the balcony to take advantage of the sea breeze on the hot night.
sentences.zh: 布莱恩为了在炎热的夜晚享受海风，把床拖到了门边，头朝向阳台睡觉。

sentences.en: The shooter had shot Brian once in the head, then left the flat and headed five kilometres east to Nedlands.
sentences.zh: 枪手朝布莱恩头部开了一枪，然后离开公寓，向东行进五公里前往内德兰兹。

sentences.en: Once in Nedlands, the shooter walked around the back of the boarding house where John Sturkey was sleeping on the rear veranda and shot him once in the head.
sentences.zh: 到达内德兰兹后，枪手绕到寄宿公寓后面，对着睡在后阳台的约翰·斯塔基头部开了一枪。

sentences.en: The shooter then walked one street over, ejecting another spent shell casing as he did so and rang the doorbell of the Wormsley residence.
sentences.zh: 枪手随后走到隔壁街道，在抛出另一个弹壳的同时，按响了沃姆斯利家的门铃。

sentences.en: George Wormsley was his last victim.
sentences.zh: 乔治·沃姆斯利是他最后的受害者。

sentences.en: It didn't appear that any of the victims were connected or had been specifically targeted.
sentences.zh: 受害者之间似乎没有任何联系，也不像是被专门针对的。

sentences.en: No fingerprints had been recovered from any of the crime scenes, nor did police find the murder weapon.
sentences.zh: 在任何犯罪现场都没有提取到指纹，警方也没有找到凶器。

sentences.en: All of the shell casings recovered had come from the same 22-gauge firearm, which was a Lithgow single-shot rifle.
sentences.zh: 所有回收的弹壳都来自同一支.22口径的枪支，即利斯戈单发步枪。

sentences.en: There were 75,000 such rifles registered in the state of
sentences.zh: 该州注册的此类步枪有75,000支。

sentences.en: Western Australia.
sentences.zh: 西澳大利亚州。

sentences.en: Police began following up on each one in search of the murder weapon and even extended their search to the eastern states of Australia.
sentences.zh: 警方开始逐一排查以寻找凶器，甚至将搜索范围扩大到了澳大利亚东部各州。

sentences.en: They test-fired a total of 60,000 rifles, but none were a match.
sentences.zh: 他们测试了总共60,000支步枪，但没有一支匹配。

sentences.en: There appeared to be a time lapse between the attacks in Cottesloe and those in Netherlands, prompting detectives to wonder if
sentences.zh: 科特斯洛和内德兰兹的袭击之间似乎存在时间差，这促使侦探们怀疑

sentences.en: the shooter had used a bike to cycle from the first location to the second.
sentences.zh: 枪手是否骑自行车从第一个地点前往第二个地点。

sentences.en: However, some witnesses had reported seeing a light-coloured Holden sedan driving in Cottesloe around the time of the first attacks.
sentences.zh: 然而，一些目击者报告说，在第一次袭击发生时，看到一辆浅色的霍顿轿车在科特斯洛行驶。

sentences.en: What made the sedan suspicious was the fact that its headlights weren't on, even though it was the middle of the night.
sentences.zh: 这辆轿车之所以可疑，是因为尽管是深夜，它却没有开大灯。

sentences.en: Witnesses in
sentences.zh: 内德兰兹的目击者报告说，看到一辆类似的车停在当地的犯罪现场附近。

sentences.en: Netherlands had reported seeing a similar car parked near the crime scenes there.
sentences.zh: 在1963年1月底发生随机枪击案之前的几年里，珀斯已经出现了一些不安的涟漪。

sentences.en: Perth had experienced some ripples of concern in the years immediately preceding the random shootings in late January 1963.
sentences.zh: 肇事逃逸的模式，以及在袭击女性居民前潜入并抢劫房屋的潜行者的报道，都引起了轰动。

sentences.en: The pattern of hit and runs and the reports of a prowler entering and robbing homes before attacking female residents had both caused a stir.
sentences.zh: 但澳大利亚日的枪击事件让整个城市陷入了彻底的恐慌。

sentences.en: But the Australia Day shootings sent the city into a full-blown panic
sentences.zh: 一夜之间，人们为了应对这些毫无意义的袭击，彻底改变了他们的习惯和行为。

sentences.en: Overnight, people completely changed their habits and behaviours in response to the senseless attacks
sentences.zh: 他们锁好门，确保晚上关上窗户。

sentences.en: They locked their doors and made sure to close their windows at night
sentences.zh: 尽管当时正值酷暑。

sentences.en: Despite the sweltering summer heat
sentences.zh: 枪支购买量激增。

sentences.en: Gun purchases skyrocketed
sentences.zh: 人们睡觉时把武器放在床边，以便随时能够拿到。

sentences.en: People slept with weapons by their bed where they could reach them at a moment's notice
sentences.zh: 其他人则凑合着用能找到的东西，包括刀具、板球棒，甚至是可以直接喷向袭击者眼睛的杀虫剂罐。

sentences.en: Others made do with what they could find, including knives, cricket bats and even cans of fly spray they could aim directly at an assailant's eyes.
sentences.zh: 动物收容所突然面临对护卫犬的巨大需求，珀斯各地的收容所里的狗都被抢购一空。

sentences.en: Animal shelters suddenly faced a huge demand for guard dogs, with pounds across Perth selling out of dogs.
sentences.zh: 当时户外厕所很常见，但越来越多的人开始在室内安装厕所，这样天黑后就根本不需要出门了。

sentences.en: Outhouses were common at the time, but more people started installing toilets inside of their houses so they wouldn't have to go outside at all after dark.
sentences.zh: 孩子们不再被允许像过去那样睡在后阳台上避暑。

sentences.en: Children were no longer allowed to sleep on back verandas to stay cool on hot nights, as they'd done in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 关于枪击事件的奇怪理论层出不穷。

sentences.en: Strange theories about the shootings emerged.
sentences.zh: 有些人虚假地承认了罪行。

sentences.en: Some people falsely confessed to the crimes.
sentences.zh: 另一些人则指出，袭击发生在满月期间。

sentences.en: Others pointed out that the attacks had taken place during a full moon.
sentences.zh: 作家罗伯特·德鲁在他的回忆录《鲨鱼网》中写道，枪击事件是如何瞬间改变珀斯的。

sentences.en: In his memoir, The Sharknet, author Robert Drew wrote about how the shootings changed Perth in an instant.
sentences.zh: 引用如下：

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: “谋杀案立即改变了这个地方的精神面貌。它们让街道两旁薄荷树、箱形树和开花桉树的温暖阴影变得冰冷。”

sentences.en: The murders immediately changed the spirit of the place They chilled the warm shadows of the peppermint and box trees and flowering gums lining the streets
sentences.zh: “砖石房屋略显斑驳的线条。”

sentences.en: The slightly crumbly lines of the brick and limestone houses
sentences.zh: “看起来舒适的仿都铎式公寓楼和店面。”

sentences.en: The cosy looking fake Tudor apartment blocks and shop fronts
sentences.zh: “变得更加尖锐、严酷。”

sentences.en: Had a sharper, harsher edge
sentences.zh: “它们的外墙看起来冷漠而封闭。”

sentences.en: Their facades looked stony and closed
sentences.zh: “人们在匆忙走进室内或钻进车里时，眼神会迅速移开。”

sentences.en: People's eyes flicked away as they hurried indoors or into their cars.
sentences.zh: “天黑后外出的居民减少了，营造出一种阴森的氛围，街道在夜晚显得格外寂静。”

sentences.en: Fewer residents went out after dark, creating an eerie atmosphere where the streets were especially quiet at night.
sentences.zh: “尽管行人和车辆交通减少了。”

sentences.en: Despite the reduced foot and vehicle traffic,
sentences.zh: “州政府安排从内德兰兹到弗里曼特尔整夜点亮路灯，作为对枪击事件的直接回应。”

sentences.en: the state government arranged to keep streetlights blazing all night long from Nedlands down to Fremantle in a direct response to the shootings.
sentences.zh: 警方承受着破案的巨大压力，日夜不停地工作以抓捕肇事者。

sentences.en: Police were under intense pressure to solve the case, working day and night to catch the person responsible.
sentences.zh: 公众打来的举报电话如潮水般涌入。

sentences.en: Calls flooded in from the public with tip-offs.
sentences.zh: 有时电话太多，甚至堵塞了总机。

sentences.en: Sometimes there were so many that they clogged up the switchboard.
sentences.zh: 专门设立了一个特别行动室来处理这些电话。

sentences.en: A special operational room was set up just to manage these calls.
sentences.zh: 当侦探们仔细梳理澳大利亚日枪击案和入室盗窃案的每一个细节时，每晚还有40名巡警在珀斯街头巡逻。

sentences.en: While detectives combed over every detail of the Australia Day shootings and break-ins, an additional 40 patrol officers were out on the streets of Perth every night
sentences.zh: 他们通过巡逻车、骑马和步行监视着这座城市。

sentences.en: watching the city from patrol cars, horseback and on foot.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，他们还是未能识别或逮捕嫌疑人。

sentences.en: Despite this, they failed to identify or apprehend a suspect.
sentences.zh: 他们也无法阻止潜行者的袭击，这些袭击在澳大利亚日枪击案后仍在继续，但被认为与此无关。

sentences.en: Nor were they able to prevent the Prowler attacks, which continued in the wake of the Australia Day shootings, but were believed to be unrelated.
sentences.zh: 露西·马德里尔在枪击案发生不到三周后被谋杀。

sentences.en: Lucy Madrill was murdered less than three weeks after the shootings.
sentences.zh: 卡梅尔·里德在四个月后遭到袭击。

sentences.en: Carmel Reed was attacked four months later.
sentences.zh: 直到八月，案件才终于有了重大进展。

sentences.en: It wasn't until August that there would finally be a significant development in the case.
sentences.zh: 未完待续。

sentences.en: To be continued.
sentences.zh: 未完待续。
